```lean
import Superconductivity.Pairing
import Superconductivity.GL
import Superconductivity.Gauge
import Mathlib.Data.Real.Sqrt

/-!
# A common finite effective functional

This file connects the independently checked amplitude and link-energy
modules.  The model uses a single selected pairing mode and the specified
normalization `alpha = 1 - lambda`.  Interpreting this coefficient as the
quadratic free energy of a real material is a modelling input, not a theorem.

We prove a precise threshold for a nonzero homogeneous amplitude, local gauge
invariance of the entire specified functional, a lower energy bound, and an
explicit uniform configuration attaining that bound when every link is one.
No thermal measure, thermodynamic limit, electromagnetic-field dynamics, or
microscopic-to-effective error bound is supplied or claimed.

All quantities are dimensionless/rescaled.  In particular `lambda` is not a
temperature; no theorem in this project assigns kelvin to an eigenvalue.
-/

open scoped BigOperators

namespace Superconductivity.Framework

/-- The real quadratic model extended to complex internal vectors by adding
its values on the real and imaginary parts.  For a real symmetric kernel
this is the usual real-valued Hermitian quadratic energy. -/
noncomputable def complexQuadraticEnergy {n : ℕ} (K : Pairing.RealKernel n)
    (z : Fin n → ℂ) : ℝ :=
  Pairing.quadraticEnergy K (fun i => (z i).re) +
    Pairing.quadraticEnergy K (fun i => (z i).im)

/-- Exact complex-amplitude projection onto a normalized real internal
eigenmode, in the explicitly specified complexified quadratic model. -/
theorem complex_eigenmode_projection {n : ℕ} (K : Pairing.RealKernel n)
    (phi : Pairing.RealVector n) (lambda : ℝ) (psi : ℂ)
    (hnormalized : Pairing.squaredNorm phi = 1)
    (heigen : ∀ i, Pairing.kernelApply K phi i = lambda * phi i) :
    complexQuadraticEnergy K (fun i => psi * (phi i : ℂ)) =
      (1 - lambda) * Complex.normSq psi := by
  simp only [complexQuadraticEnergy, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
    Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, mul_zero, zero_add, sub_zero]
  rw [Pairing.normalized_eigenmode_energy K phi lambda psi.re hnormalized heigen,
    Pairing.normalized_eigenmode_energy K phi lambda psi.im hnormalized heigen]
  simp only [Complex.normSq_apply]
  ring

/-- Adding the specified positive-quartic form gives exactly the local GL
polynomial used below.  The quartic coefficient is still input data. -/
theorem projected_quartic_matches_GL {n : ℕ} (K : Pairing.RealKernel n)
    (phi : Pairing.RealVector n) (lambda beta : ℝ) (psi : ℂ)
    (hnormalized : Pairing.squaredNorm phi = 1)
    (heigen : ∀ i, Pairing.kernelApply K phi i = lambda * phi i) :
    complexQuadraticEnergy K (fun i => psi * (phi i : ℂ)) +
        (beta / 2) * (Complex.normSq psi) ^ 2 =
      GL.freeEnergy (1 - lambda) beta (Complex.normSq psi) := by
  rw [complex_eigenmode_projection K phi lambda psi hnormalized heigen]
  rfl

/-- In the selected-mode normalization, a nonzero minimizing amplitude exists
exactly above the strict threshold `lambda > 1`.  The quartic term is positive.
This is a theorem of the given homogeneous effective polynomial. -/
theorem nonzero_minimizer_iff (lambda beta : ℝ) (hbeta : 0 < beta) :
    (∃ x : ℝ, 0 < x ∧ GL.IsMinimizerOnNonnegative (1 - lambda) beta x) ↔
      1 < lambda := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, hmin⟩
    by_contra hnot
    have ha : 0 ≤ 1 - lambda := sub_nonneg.mpr (le_of_not_gt hnot)
    have hxzero := (GL.normal_unique_minimizer (1 - lambda) beta x ha hbeta).mp hmin
    exact (ne_of_gt hx) hxzero
  · intro hlambda
    have ha : 1 - lambda < 0 := sub_neg.mpr hlambda
    refine ⟨-(1 - lambda) / beta,
      GL.ordered_amplitude_positive (1 - lambda) beta ha hbeta, ?_⟩
    exact (GL.ordered_unique_minimizer (1 - lambda) beta
      (-(1 - lambda) / beta) ha hbeta).mpr rfl

/-- Explicit ordered amplitude in the selected-mode normalization. -/
theorem mode_ordered_unique_minimizer (lambda beta x : ℝ)
    (hlambda : 1 < lambda) (hbeta : 0 < beta) :
    GL.IsMinimizerOnNonnegative (1 - lambda) beta x ↔
      x = (lambda - 1) / beta := by
  simpa only [neg_sub] using
    GL.ordered_unique_minimizer (1 - lambda) beta x
      (sub_neg.mpr hlambda) hbeta

/-- At the threshold itself the minimizing amplitude is still zero. -/
theorem threshold_minimizer_is_zero (beta x : ℝ) (hbeta : 0 < beta) :
    GL.IsMinimizerOnNonnegative (1 - (1 : ℝ)) beta x ↔ x = 0 := by
  exact GL.normal_unique_minimizer (1 - (1 : ℝ)) beta x (by norm_num) hbeta

section FiniteFunctional

variable {Vertex Edge : Type*} [Fintype Vertex] [Fintype Edge]

/-- A specified single-mode, finite, charged GL-type functional.
The coefficients, graph and links are inputs, not derived material data. -/
noncomputable def energy (alpha beta : ℝ) (src dst : Edge → Vertex) (weight : Edge → ℝ)
    (psi : Vertex → ℂ) (link : Edge → ℂ) : ℝ :=
  (∑ v, GL.freeEnergy alpha beta (Complex.normSq (psi v))) +
    Gauge.gaugeEnergy src dst weight psi link

/-- The entire local-plus-link functional respects the same local unit-phase
transformation as its covariant gradient term. -/
theorem energy_gauge_invariant (alpha beta : ℝ) (src dst : Edge → Vertex)
    (weight : Edge → ℝ) (psi g : Vertex → ℂ) (link : Edge → ℂ)
    (hg : ∀ v, Gauge.IsUnitPhase (g v)) :
    energy alpha beta src dst weight
        (fun v => Gauge.gaugeMatter (g v) (psi v))
        (fun e => Gauge.gaugeLink (g (src e)) (g (dst e)) (link e)) =
      energy alpha beta src dst weight psi link := by
  unfold energy
  rw [Gauge.gaugeEnergy_invariant src dst weight psi g link hg]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro v _
  rw [Gauge.amplitude_sq_invariant (g v) (psi v) (hg v)]

/-- Nonnegative local quadratic coefficient and edge weights imply a
nonnegative total free-energy difference. -/
theorem normal_energy_nonnegative (alpha beta : ℝ) (src dst : Edge → Vertex)
    (weight : Edge → ℝ) (psi : Vertex → ℂ) (link : Edge → ℂ)
    (halpha : 0 ≤ alpha) (hbeta : 0 ≤ beta) (hweight : ∀ e, 0 ≤ weight e) :
    0 ≤ energy alpha beta src dst weight psi link := by
  unfold energy
  apply add_nonneg
  · exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun v _ =>
      GL.normal_energy_nonnegative alpha beta (Complex.normSq (psi v))
        halpha hbeta (Complex.normSq_nonneg _)
  · exact Gauge.gaugeEnergy_nonnegative src dst weight psi link hweight

/-- The zero field always has zero energy, including for nontrivial links. -/
theorem zero_field_energy (alpha beta : ℝ) (src dst : Edge → Vertex)
    (weight : Edge → ℝ) (link : Edge → ℂ) :
    energy alpha beta src dst weight (fun _ => 0) link = 0 := by
  simp [energy, GL.freeEnergy, Gauge.gaugeEnergy, Gauge.edgeEnergy,
    Gauge.edgeDifference]

/-- Zero is a global minimizing configuration in the normal coefficient
regime.  This statement does not assert a physical thermodynamic transition. -/
theorem normal_zero_global_minimum (alpha beta : ℝ) (src dst : Edge → Vertex)
    (weight : Edge → ℝ) (psi : Vertex → ℂ) (link : Edge → ℂ)
    (halpha : 0 ≤ alpha) (hbeta : 0 ≤ beta) (hweight : ∀ e, 0 ≤ weight e) :
    energy alpha beta src dst weight (fun _ => 0) link ≤
      energy alpha beta src dst weight psi link := by
  rw [zero_field_energy]
  exact normal_energy_nonnegative alpha beta src dst weight psi link
    halpha hbeta hweight

/-- A lower bound valid for every field and every complex link.  With
frustrating links this bound need not be attained. -/
theorem energy_lower_bound (alpha beta : ℝ) (src dst : Edge → Vertex)
    (weight : Edge → ℝ) (psi : Vertex → ℂ) (link : Edge → ℂ)
    (hbeta : 0 < beta) (hweight : ∀ e, 0 ≤ weight e) :
    (∑ _v : Vertex, GL.freeEnergy alpha beta (-alpha / beta)) ≤
      energy alpha beta src dst weight psi link := by
  have hlocal : (∑ _v : Vertex, GL.freeEnergy alpha beta (-alpha / beta)) ≤
      ∑ v, GL.freeEnergy alpha beta (Complex.normSq (psi v)) := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro v _
    exact GL.vertex_is_global_lower_bound alpha beta (Complex.normSq (psi v)) hbeta
  exact le_trans hlocal (le_add_of_nonneg_right
    (Gauge.gaugeEnergy_nonnegative src dst weight psi link hweight))

/-- An explicit constant complex field with squared amplitude `x` for `x>=0`.
The real square root is used only to construct an attaining configuration. -/
noncomputable def uniformField (x : ℝ) : Vertex → ℂ :=
  fun _ => (Real.sqrt x : ℂ)

theorem uniformField_normSq (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (v : Vertex) :
    Complex.normSq (uniformField x v) = x := by
  exact (Complex.normSq_ofReal (Real.sqrt x)).trans (Real.mul_self_sqrt hx)

/-- On a nonempty vertex set, a strictly positive prescribed squared
amplitude gives a field that is genuinely not the zero function. -/
theorem uniformField_ne_zero [Nonempty Vertex] (x : ℝ) (hx : 0 < x) :
    (uniformField x : Vertex → ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
  intro hzero
  obtain ⟨v⟩ := (inferInstance : Nonempty Vertex)
  have hv : uniformField x v = 0 := congrFun hzero v
  have hnorm := uniformField_normSq x (le_of_lt hx) v
  rw [hv, Complex.normSq_zero] at hnorm
  exact (ne_of_gt hx) hnorm.symm

/-- Constant fields have zero link energy when every link is one. -/
theorem uniformField_zero_gradient (x : ℝ) (src dst : Edge → Vertex)
    (weight : Edge → ℝ) :
    Gauge.gaugeEnergy src dst weight (uniformField x) (fun _ => 1) = 0 := by
  simp [Gauge.gaugeEnergy, Gauge.edgeEnergy, Gauge.edgeDifference, uniformField]

/-- In the unfrustrated case the explicit uniform field attains the lower
bound.  No connectedness assumption is needed for existence. -/
theorem uniformField_attains_bound (alpha beta : ℝ) (src dst : Edge → Vertex)
    (weight : Edge → ℝ) (halpha : alpha < 0) (hbeta : 0 < beta) :
    energy alpha beta src dst weight (uniformField (-alpha / beta)) (fun _ => 1) =
      ∑ _v : Vertex, GL.freeEnergy alpha beta (-alpha / beta) := by
  have hx := le_of_lt (GL.ordered_amplitude_positive alpha beta halpha hbeta)
  unfold energy
  rw [uniformField_zero_gradient, add_zero]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro v _
  rw [uniformField_normSq (-alpha / beta) hx v]

/-- Main global-minimum result for the specified finite functional: positive
quartic coefficient, nonnegative edge weights and unfrustrated unit links
admit an explicitly constructed uniform minimizing field when `alpha<0`.
The theorem proves existence and optimality, not uniqueness of all minimizers. -/
theorem ordered_uniform_global_minimum (alpha beta : ℝ) (src dst : Edge → Vertex)
    (weight : Edge → ℝ) (psi : Vertex → ℂ)
    (halpha : alpha < 0) (hbeta : 0 < beta) (hweight : ∀ e, 0 ≤ weight e) :
    energy alpha beta src dst weight (uniformField (-alpha / beta)) (fun _ => 1) ≤
      energy alpha beta src dst weight psi (fun _ => 1) := by
  rw [uniformField_attains_bound alpha beta src dst weight halpha hbeta]
  exact energy_lower_bound alpha beta src dst weight psi (fun _ => 1) hbeta hweight

/-- The selected-mode threshold feeds into the finite functional: for
`lambda>1`, the explicit field has positive squared amplitude and is a global
minimum in the unfrustrated model with nonnegative couplings. -/
theorem mode_uniform_global_minimum (lambda beta : ℝ) (src dst : Edge → Vertex)
    (weight : Edge → ℝ) (psi : Vertex → ℂ)
    (hlambda : 1 < lambda) (hbeta : 0 < beta) (hweight : ∀ e, 0 ≤ weight e) :
    energy (1 - lambda) beta src dst weight
        (uniformField ((lambda - 1) / beta)) (fun _ => 1) ≤
      energy (1 - lambda) beta src dst weight psi (fun _ => 1) := by
  simpa only [neg_sub] using ordered_uniform_global_minimum (1 - lambda) beta
    src dst weight psi (sub_neg.mpr hlambda) hbeta hweight

/-- A nonvacuous existence theorem: the graph has at least one vertex, and
the constructed global minimizing field is not the zero function. -/
theorem exists_nonzero_global_minimum [Nonempty Vertex]
    (lambda beta : ℝ) (src dst : Edge → Vertex) (weight : Edge → ℝ)
    (hlambda : 1 < lambda) (hbeta : 0 < beta) (hweight : ∀ e, 0 ≤ weight e) :
    ∃ psi : Vertex → ℂ, psi ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ other : Vertex → ℂ,
        energy (1 - lambda) beta src dst weight psi (fun _ => 1) ≤
          energy (1 - lambda) beta src dst weight other (fun _ => 1) := by
  refine ⟨uniformField ((lambda - 1) / beta), ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact uniformField_ne_zero ((lambda - 1) / beta)
      (div_pos (sub_pos.mpr hlambda) hbeta)
  · intro other
    exact mode_uniform_global_minimum lambda beta src dst weight other
      hlambda hbeta hweight

end FiniteFunctional

end Superconductivity.Framework
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compile this project's exact source and audit every declared theorem.

Normal use, after `lake update` and the documented cache download:
    python3 verify.py

The optional paths reuse the already-installed official Mathlib environment
in this conversation. They change source/module search paths, not proof terms.
    python3 verify.py --mathlib-root /absolute/mathlib4 \
        --runtime-wrapper /absolute/with_lean.sh

This script is an audit driver, not a proof checker. Lean checks the proofs.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import datetime as dt
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys


MODULES = ["Pairing", "GL", "Gauge", "Framework"]
ALLOWED_AXIOMS = {"propext", "Classical.choice", "Quot.sound"}
EXPECTED_MATHLIB = "f897ebcf72cd16f89ab4577d0c826cd14afaafc7"


def strip_comments(text: str) -> str:
    """Remove nested Lean block comments and line comments for a source scan."""
    out, i, depth = [], 0, 0
    while i < len(text):
        if text.startswith("/-", i):
            depth += 1
            out.extend("  ")
            i += 2
        elif depth and text.startswith("-/", i):
            depth -= 1
            out.extend("  ")
            i += 2
        elif depth:
            out.append("\n" if text[i] == "\n" else " ")
            i += 1
        elif text.startswith("--", i):
            j = text.find("\n", i)
            if j < 0:
                break
            out.extend(" " * (j - i))
            i = j
        else:
            out.append(text[i])
            i += 1
    if depth:
        raise ValueError("Unterminated Lean comment")
    return "".join(out)


def sha256(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--mathlib-root", type=Path)
    ap.add_argument("--runtime-wrapper", type=Path)
    args = ap.parse_args()
    root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    base = args.mathlib_root.resolve() if args.mathlib_root else root
    wrapper = [str(args.runtime_wrapper.resolve())] if args.runtime_wrapper else []
    started = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc)
    stamp = started.strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%S_%fZ")
    out_dir = root / "build" / stamp
    lib_dir = out_dir / "lib" / "lean"
    (lib_dir / "Superconductivity").mkdir(parents=True)
    records: list[dict] = []
    log_parts: list[str] = []
    report: dict = {
        "started_utc": started.isoformat(),
        "status": "running",
        "scope": "finite dimensionless effective-model theorems; no material or Tc claim",
        "allowed_axioms": sorted(ALLOWED_AXIOMS),
        "fresh_build_directory": str(out_dir.relative_to(root)),
        "commands": records,
    }

    def run(command: list[str], cwd: Path, env: dict | None = None) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
        p = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
        record = {"argv": command, "cwd": str(cwd), "exit_code": p.returncode,
                  "stdout": p.stdout, "stderr": p.stderr}
        records.append(record)
        log_parts.append(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
        if p.returncode:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Command failed ({p.returncode}): {command}\n{p.stdout}{p.stderr}")
        return p

    try:
        theorem_names: list[str] = []
        source_files = [root / "Superconductivity" / f"{m}.lean" for m in MODULES]
        source_files.append(root / "Superconductivity.lean")
        hashes = {str(p.relative_to(root)): sha256(p) for p in source_files}
        forbidden = r"\b(?:sorry|admit|axiom|unsafe|partial|native_decide|run_elab)\b"
        for m in MODULES:
            clean = strip_comments((root / "Superconductivity" / f"{m}.lean").read_text())
            match = re.search(forbidden, clean)
            if match:
                raise RuntimeError(f"Forbidden proof/source token {match.group()} in {m}")
            names = re.findall(r"(?m)^theorem\s+([A-Za-z0-9_]+)\b", clean)
            theorem_names.extend(f"Superconductivity.{m}.{name}" for name in names)
        if not theorem_names:
            raise RuntimeError("No theorem declarations found")
        audit = root / "Audit.lean"
        audit.write_text("import Superconductivity\n\n" + "\n".join(
            f"#print axioms {name}" for name in theorem_names) + "\n")
        hashes["Audit.lean"] = sha256(audit)
        report["source_sha256"] = hashes
        report["theorem_count"] = len(theorem_names)
        report["theorems"] = theorem_names
        version = run(wrapper + ["lake", "env", "lean", "--version"], base).stdout.strip()
        report["lean_version"] = version
        if "version 4.24.0," not in version:
            raise RuntimeError("Unexpected Lean version")
        mathlib_checkout = base if args.mathlib_root else root / ".lake" / "packages" / "mathlib"
        commit = run(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], mathlib_checkout).stdout.strip()
        report["mathlib_commit"] = commit
        if commit != EXPECTED_MATHLIB:
            raise RuntimeError("Unexpected Mathlib commit")
        report["verification_driver_sha256"] = sha256(Path(__file__).resolve())
        lean_prefix = run(wrapper + ["lake", "env", "lean", "--print-prefix"], base).stdout.strip()
        lean_exe = str(Path(lean_prefix) / "bin" / "lean")
        # Read only the module search path; no credentials or other environment
        # variables are printed or recorded.
        path_probe = subprocess.run(wrapper + ["lake", "env", sys.executable, "-c",
            "import os; print(os.environ.get('LEAN_PATH',''))"], cwd=base,
            capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
        lean_path = path_probe.stdout.strip()
        env = dict(os.environ)
        env["LEAN_PATH"] = str(lib_dir) + os.pathsep + lean_path
        report["lean_path"] = env["LEAN_PATH"]
        for m in MODULES:
            source = root / "Superconductivity" / f"{m}.lean"
            output = lib_dir / "Superconductivity" / f"{m}.olean"
            run(wrapper + [lean_exe, f"--root={root}", "-o", str(output), str(source)], root, env)
            print(f"COMPILED {m}.lean", flush=True)
        run(wrapper + [lean_exe, f"--root={root}", "-o", str(lib_dir / "Superconductivity.olean"),
                       str(root / "Superconductivity.lean")], root, env)
        axiom_output = run(wrapper + [lean_exe, f"--root={root}", str(audit)], root, env).stdout
        if "sorryAx" in axiom_output:
            raise RuntimeError("A proof depends on sorryAx")
        axiom_lists = re.findall(r"depends on axioms:\s*\[([^\]]*)\]", axiom_output)
        no_axioms = re.findall(r"does not depend on any axioms", axiom_output)
        if len(axiom_lists) + len(no_axioms) != len(theorem_names):
            raise RuntimeError("Axiom output does not cover every declared theorem")
        dependencies = set()
        for group in axiom_lists:
            dependencies.update(a.strip() for a in group.split(",") if a.strip())
        report["observed_axioms"] = sorted(dependencies)
        if dependencies - ALLOWED_AXIOMS:
            raise RuntimeError(f"Unexpected axioms: {dependencies - ALLOWED_AXIOMS}")
        for relative, digest in hashes.items():
            if sha256(root / relative) != digest:
                raise RuntimeError(f"Source changed during verification: {relative}")
        report["status"] = "passed"
        print(f"PASSED: {len(theorem_names)} theorem axiom audits; all source unchanged", flush=True)
    except Exception as error:
        report["status"] = "failed"
        report["error"] = str(error)
        print(str(error), file=sys.stderr, flush=True)
    finally:
        report["finished_utc"] = dt.datetime.now(dt.timezone.utc).isoformat()
        (out_dir / "verification.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
        (out_dir / "verification.log").write_text("\n\n".join(log_parts) + "\n")
        (root / "verification.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")
        (root / "verification.log").write_text("\n\n".join(log_parts) + "\n")
    return 0 if report["status"] == "passed" else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
```

```lean
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Sqrt
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Deriv
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Deriv
import Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
import Mathlib.Tactic.Positivity

/-!
# A finite scalar BCS free energy

This is a specified finite, separable mean-field model. The derivative identities
hold for arbitrary real weights; physical positivity is imposed separately.
`τ` is positive and the differentiability domain is the open set where every
`ξ i ^ 2 + x` is positive. No thermodynamic-limit claim is made here.
-/

noncomputable section

open scoped BigOperators Topology

namespace Superconductivity.BCSBridge

def quasiparticleEnergy (ξ x : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.sqrt (ξ ^ 2 + x)

def shellLog (τ ξ x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.log (Real.cosh (quasiparticleEnergy ξ x / (2 * τ)))

def shellTerm (τ ξ x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  2 * τ * (shellLog τ ξ x - Real.log (Real.cosh (ξ / (2 * τ))))

def shellResponse (τ ξ x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  Real.tanh (quasiparticleEnergy ξ x / (2 * τ)) /
    (2 * quasiparticleEnergy ξ x)

variable {Shell : Type*} [Fintype Shell]

def freeEnergy (τ g : ℝ) (ξ w : Shell → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  x / g - ∑ i, w i * shellTerm τ (ξ i) x

def gapResidual (τ g : ℝ) (ξ w : Shell → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  1 / g - ∑ i, w i * shellResponse τ (ξ i) x

def normalSusceptibility (τ : ℝ) (ξ w : Shell → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i, w i * Real.tanh (ξ i / (2 * τ)) / (2 * ξ i)

def pairingEigenvalue (τ g : ℝ) (ξ w : Shell → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  g * normalSusceptibility τ ξ w

def linearizedKernel (τ g : ℝ) (ξ w : Shell → ℝ) (_i j : Shell) : ℝ :=
  g * (w j * Real.tanh (ξ j / (2 * τ)) / (2 * ξ j))

theorem quasiparticleEnergy_pos {ξ x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < ξ ^ 2 + x) :
    0 < quasiparticleEnergy ξ x := Real.sqrt_pos.2 hx

theorem quasiparticleEnergy_zero {ξ : ℝ} (hξ : 0 ≤ ξ) :
    quasiparticleEnergy ξ 0 = ξ := by
  simp [quasiparticleEnergy, Real.sqrt_sq hξ]

theorem shellTerm_zero (τ : ℝ) {ξ : ℝ} (hξ : 0 ≤ ξ) :
    shellTerm τ ξ 0 = 0 := by
  simp [shellTerm, shellLog, quasiparticleEnergy_zero hξ]

theorem freeEnergy_zero (τ g : ℝ) (ξ w : Shell → ℝ) (hξ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ ξ i) :
    freeEnergy τ g ξ w 0 = 0 := by
  have hz (i : Shell) := shellTerm_zero τ (hξ i)
  simp [freeEnergy, hz]

theorem hasDerivAt_quasiparticleEnergy {ξ x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < ξ ^ 2 + x) :
    HasDerivAt (quasiparticleEnergy ξ)
      (1 / (2 * quasiparticleEnergy ξ x)) x := by
  simpa [quasiparticleEnergy] using
    ((hasDerivAt_const x (ξ ^ 2)).add (hasDerivAt_id x)).sqrt (ne_of_gt hx)

theorem hasDerivAt_shellLog {τ ξ x : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ)
    (hx : 0 < ξ ^ 2 + x) :
    HasDerivAt (shellLog τ ξ)
      (Real.tanh (quasiparticleEnergy ξ x / (2 * τ)) /
        (4 * τ * quasiparticleEnergy ξ x)) x := by
  have hE := hasDerivAt_quasiparticleEnergy hx
  have h := ((hE.div_const (2 * τ)).cosh).log
    (ne_of_gt (Real.cosh_pos (quasiparticleEnergy ξ x / (2 * τ))))
  refine h.congr_deriv ?_
  rw [Real.tanh_eq_sinh_div_cosh]
  field_simp [ne_of_gt hτ, ne_of_gt (quasiparticleEnergy_pos hx),
    ne_of_gt (Real.cosh_pos (quasiparticleEnergy ξ x / (2 * τ)))]
  ring

theorem hasDerivAt_shellTerm {τ ξ x : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ)
    (hx : 0 < ξ ^ 2 + x) :
    HasDerivAt (shellTerm τ ξ) (shellResponse τ ξ x) x := by
  have h := ((hasDerivAt_shellLog hτ hx).sub_const
    (Real.log (Real.cosh (ξ / (2 * τ))))).const_mul (2 * τ)
  refine h.congr_deriv ?_
  unfold shellResponse
  field_simp [ne_of_gt hτ]
  ring

theorem hasDerivAt_freeEnergy {τ g x : ℝ} (ξ w : Shell → ℝ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hx : ∀ i, 0 < ξ i ^ 2 + x) :
    HasDerivAt (freeEnergy τ g ξ w) (gapResidual τ g ξ w x) x := by
  have hs := HasDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ)
    (fun i (_hi : i ∈ Finset.univ) =>
      (hasDerivAt_shellTerm hτ (hx i)).const_mul (w i))
  exact ((hasDerivAt_id x).div_const g).sub hs

theorem deriv_freeEnergy {τ g x : ℝ} (ξ w : Shell → ℝ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hx : ∀ i, 0 < ξ i ^ 2 + x) :
    deriv (freeEnergy τ g ξ w) x = gapResidual τ g ξ w x :=
  (hasDerivAt_freeEnergy ξ w hτ hx).deriv

theorem gapResidual_zero {τ g : ℝ} (ξ w : Shell → ℝ)
    (hξ : ∀ i, 0 ≤ ξ i) :
    gapResidual τ g ξ w 0 = 1 / g - normalSusceptibility τ ξ w := by
  simp only [gapResidual, shellResponse, quasiparticleEnergy_zero (hξ _),
    normalSusceptibility, mul_div_assoc]

theorem hasDerivAt_freeEnergy_zero_lambda {τ g : ℝ} (ξ w : Shell → ℝ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hg : g ≠ 0) (hξ : ∀ i, 0 < ξ i) :
    HasDerivAt (freeEnergy τ g ξ w) ((1 - pairingEigenvalue τ g ξ w) / g) 0 := by
  have h := hasDerivAt_freeEnergy (g := g) (x := 0) ξ w hτ
    (fun i => by simpa using sq_pos_of_pos (hξ i))
  refine h.congr_deriv ?_
  rw [gapResidual_zero ξ w (fun i => (hξ i).le)]
  unfold pairingEigenvalue
  field_simp

theorem zero_gap_derivative_neg_iff {τ g : ℝ} (ξ w : Shell → ℝ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hg : 0 < g) (hξ : ∀ i, 0 < ξ i) :
    deriv (freeEnergy τ g ξ w) 0 < 0 ↔ 1 < pairingEigenvalue τ g ξ w := by
  rw [(hasDerivAt_freeEnergy_zero_lambda ξ w hτ (ne_of_gt hg) hξ).deriv,
    div_lt_iff₀ hg]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

theorem constant_gap_eigenvector (τ g : ℝ) (ξ w : Shell → ℝ) (i : Shell) :
    (∑ j, linearizedKernel τ g ξ w i j * 1) =
      pairingEigenvalue τ g ξ w * 1 := by
  simp [linearizedKernel, pairingEigenvalue, normalSusceptibility, Finset.mul_sum]

omit [Fintype Shell] in
theorem constant_gap_ne_zero [Nonempty Shell] : (fun _ : Shell => (1 : ℝ)) ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have hi := congrFun h (Classical.arbitrary Shell)
  norm_num at hi

end Superconductivity.BCSBridge
```

```lean
import Superconductivity.BCSBridge

/-!
# Actual second derivatives and positive scalar BCS curvature

The quartic coefficient in `a*x + b*x^2/2` is `b = Ω''(0)`.
The equations below differentiate the original finite BCS potential and transport
the first-derivative formula through an open neighborhood. No Taylor remainder
or material interpretation is assumed in this module.
-/

noncomputable section

open scoped BigOperators Topology

namespace Superconductivity.BCSCurvature

open BCSBridge

def curvatureKernel (τ ξ x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  (Real.tanh (quasiparticleEnergy ξ x / (2 * τ)) -
    (quasiparticleEnergy ξ x / (2 * τ)) /
      Real.cosh (quasiparticleEnergy ξ x / (2 * τ)) ^ 2) /
    (4 * quasiparticleEnergy ξ x ^ 3)

variable {Shell : Type*} [Fintype Shell]

def curvature (τ : ℝ) (ξ w : Shell → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i, w i * curvatureKernel τ (ξ i) x

theorem hasDerivAt_tanh (z : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt Real.tanh (1 / Real.cosh z ^ 2) z := by
  have h := (Real.hasDerivAt_sinh z).div (Real.hasDerivAt_cosh z)
    (ne_of_gt (Real.cosh_pos z))
  convert h using 1
  · ext y
    exact Real.tanh_eq_sinh_div_cosh y
  · simp only [← pow_two, Real.cosh_sq_sub_sinh_sq]

theorem hasDerivAt_shellResponse {τ ξ x : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ)
    (hx : 0 < ξ ^ 2 + x) :
    HasDerivAt (shellResponse τ ξ) (-curvatureKernel τ ξ x) x := by
  have hE := hasDerivAt_quasiparticleEnergy hx
  have hT := (hasDerivAt_tanh (quasiparticleEnergy ξ x / (2 * τ))).comp x
    (hE.div_const (2 * τ))
  have h := hT.div (hE.const_mul 2)
    (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (ne_of_gt (quasiparticleEnergy_pos hx)))
  refine h.congr_deriv ?_
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  unfold curvatureKernel
  field_simp [ne_of_gt hτ, ne_of_gt (quasiparticleEnergy_pos hx),
    ne_of_gt (Real.cosh_pos (quasiparticleEnergy ξ x / (2 * τ)))]
  ring

theorem hasDerivAt_gapResidual {τ g x : ℝ} (ξ w : Shell → ℝ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hx : ∀ i, 0 < ξ i ^ 2 + x) :
    HasDerivAt (gapResidual τ g ξ w) (curvature τ ξ w x) x := by
  have hs := HasDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ)
    (fun i (_hi : i ∈ Finset.univ) =>
      (hasDerivAt_shellResponse hτ (hx i)).const_mul (w i))
  have h := (hasDerivAt_const x (1 / g)).sub hs
  refine h.congr_deriv ?_
  simp [curvature, mul_neg, Finset.sum_neg_distrib]

theorem eventually_positive_radicands {x : ℝ} (ξ : Shell → ℝ)
    (hx : ∀ i, 0 < ξ i ^ 2 + x) :
    ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, ∀ i, 0 < ξ i ^ 2 + y := by
  apply Filter.eventually_all.2
  intro i
  exact continuousAt_const.eventually_lt
    (continuousAt_const.add continuousAt_id) (hx i)

theorem hasDerivAt_deriv_freeEnergy {τ g x : ℝ} (ξ w : Shell → ℝ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hx : ∀ i, 0 < ξ i ^ 2 + x) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (freeEnergy τ g ξ w)) (curvature τ ξ w x) x := by
  apply (hasDerivAt_gapResidual ξ w hτ hx).congr_of_eventuallyEq
  exact (eventually_positive_radicands ξ hx).mono
    (fun y hy => deriv_freeEnergy ξ w hτ hy)

theorem deriv_deriv_freeEnergy {τ g x : ℝ} (ξ w : Shell → ℝ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hx : ∀ i, 0 < ξ i ^ 2 + x) :
    deriv (deriv (freeEnergy τ g ξ w)) x = curvature τ ξ w x :=
  (hasDerivAt_deriv_freeEnergy ξ w hτ hx).deriv

theorem deriv_deriv_freeEnergy_zero {τ g : ℝ} (ξ w : Shell → ℝ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : ∀ i, 0 < ξ i) :
    deriv (deriv (freeEnergy τ g ξ w)) 0 = curvature τ ξ w 0 := by
  exact deriv_deriv_freeEnergy ξ w hτ
    (fun i => by simpa using sq_pos_of_pos (hξ i))

theorem hasDerivAt_deriv_shellTerm {τ ξ x : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ)
    (hx : 0 < ξ ^ 2 + x) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (shellTerm τ ξ)) (-curvatureKernel τ ξ x) x := by
  apply (hasDerivAt_shellResponse hτ hx).congr_of_eventuallyEq
  have he : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, 0 < ξ ^ 2 + y :=
    continuousAt_const.eventually_lt (continuousAt_const.add continuousAt_id) hx
  exact he.mono (fun y hy => (hasDerivAt_shellTerm hτ hy).deriv)

theorem deriv_deriv_shellTerm {τ ξ x : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ)
    (hx : 0 < ξ ^ 2 + x) :
    deriv (deriv (shellTerm τ ξ)) x = -curvatureKernel τ ξ x :=
  (hasDerivAt_deriv_shellTerm hτ hx).deriv

theorem tanh_sub_response_pos {z : ℝ} (hz : 0 < z) :
    0 < Real.tanh z - z / Real.cosh z ^ 2 := by
  have hc := Real.cosh_pos z
  have hs : z < Real.sinh z * Real.cosh z := by
    have h := Real.self_lt_sinh_iff.2 (show 0 < 2 * z by linarith)
    rw [Real.sinh_two_mul] at h
    nlinarith
  have heq : Real.tanh z - z / Real.cosh z ^ 2 =
      (Real.sinh z * Real.cosh z - z) / Real.cosh z ^ 2 := by
    rw [Real.tanh_eq_sinh_div_cosh]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hc]
  rw [heq]
  exact div_pos (sub_pos.2 hs) (sq_pos_of_pos hc)

theorem curvatureKernel_pos {τ ξ x : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ)
    (hx : 0 < ξ ^ 2 + x) :
    0 < curvatureKernel τ ξ x := by
  have hE := quasiparticleEnergy_pos hx
  unfold curvatureKernel
  exact div_pos (tanh_sub_response_pos (div_pos hE (by positivity))) (by positivity)

theorem curvature_nonneg {τ x : ℝ} (ξ w : Shell → ℝ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hx : ∀ i, 0 < ξ i ^ 2 + x) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i) :
    0 ≤ curvature τ ξ w x := by
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ => mul_nonneg (hw i) (curvatureKernel_pos hτ (hx i)).le)

theorem curvature_pos {τ x : ℝ} (ξ w : Shell → ℝ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hx : ∀ i, 0 < ξ i ^ 2 + x) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
    (hwp : ∃ i, 0 < w i) :
    0 < curvature τ ξ w x := by
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hwp
  exact Finset.sum_pos' (fun j _ => mul_nonneg (hw j) (curvatureKernel_pos hτ (hx j)).le)
    ⟨i, Finset.mem_univ i, mul_pos hi (curvatureKernel_pos hτ (hx i))⟩

end Superconductivity.BCSCurvature
```

```lean
import Superconductivity.BCSCurvature

/-!
# An explicit third derivative of the finite BCS free energy

This module differentiates the curvature kernel and identifies the result with
the actual third derivative through open-neighborhood equalities.
-/

noncomputable section

open scoped BigOperators Topology

namespace Superconductivity.BCSThirdDerivative

open BCSBridge BCSCurvature

def thirdKernel (τ ξ x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  let E := quasiparticleEnergy ξ x
  let z := E / (2 * τ)
  (2 * z ^ 2 * Real.tanh z / Real.cosh z ^ 2 -
    3 * Real.tanh z + 3 * z / Real.cosh z ^ 2) / (8 * E ^ 5)

variable {Shell : Type*} [Fintype Shell]

def thirdDerivative (τ : ℝ) (ξ w : Shell → ℝ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i, w i * thirdKernel τ (ξ i) x

theorem hasDerivAt_curvatureKernel {τ ξ x : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ)
    (hx : 0 < ξ ^ 2 + x) :
    HasDerivAt (curvatureKernel τ ξ) (thirdKernel τ ξ x) x := by
  have hE := hasDerivAt_quasiparticleEnergy hx
  have hZ := hE.div_const (2 * τ)
  have hC := hZ.cosh
  have hT := (hasDerivAt_tanh (quasiparticleEnergy ξ x / (2 * τ))).comp x hZ
  have hN := hT.sub (hZ.div (hC.pow 2)
    (pow_ne_zero 2 (ne_of_gt (Real.cosh_pos _))))
  have h := hN.div ((hE.pow 3).const_mul 4)
    (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (pow_ne_zero 3 (ne_of_gt (quasiparticleEnergy_pos hx))))
  refine h.congr_deriv ?_
  dsimp only [Function.comp_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.div_apply, Pi.pow_apply]
  unfold thirdKernel
  simp only [Real.tanh_eq_sinh_div_cosh]
  field_simp [ne_of_gt hτ, ne_of_gt (quasiparticleEnergy_pos hx),
    ne_of_gt (Real.cosh_pos (quasiparticleEnergy ξ x / (2 * τ)))]
  ring

theorem hasDerivAt_curvature {τ x : ℝ} (ξ w : Shell → ℝ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hx : ∀ i, 0 < ξ i ^ 2 + x) :
    HasDerivAt (curvature τ ξ w) (thirdDerivative τ ξ w x) x := by
  exact HasDerivAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ)
    (fun i (_hi : i ∈ Finset.univ) =>
      (hasDerivAt_curvatureKernel hτ (hx i)).const_mul (w i))

theorem hasDerivAt_deriv_deriv_freeEnergy {τ g x : ℝ} (ξ w : Shell → ℝ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hx : ∀ i, 0 < ξ i ^ 2 + x) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (deriv (freeEnergy τ g ξ w)))
      (thirdDerivative τ ξ w x) x := by
  apply (hasDerivAt_curvature ξ w hτ hx).congr_of_eventuallyEq
  exact (eventually_positive_radicands ξ hx).mono
    (fun y hy => deriv_deriv_freeEnergy ξ w hτ hy)

theorem deriv_deriv_deriv_freeEnergy {τ g x : ℝ} (ξ w : Shell → ℝ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hx : ∀ i, 0 < ξ i ^ 2 + x) :
    deriv (deriv (deriv (freeEnergy τ g ξ w))) x = thirdDerivative τ ξ w x :=
  (hasDerivAt_deriv_deriv_freeEnergy ξ w hτ hx).deriv

theorem hasDerivAt_deriv_deriv_shellTerm {τ ξ x : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ)
    (hx : 0 < ξ ^ 2 + x) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (deriv (shellTerm τ ξ))) (-thirdKernel τ ξ x) x := by
  apply (hasDerivAt_curvatureKernel hτ hx).neg.congr_of_eventuallyEq
  have he : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 x, 0 < ξ ^ 2 + y :=
    continuousAt_const.eventually_lt (continuousAt_const.add continuousAt_id) hx
  exact he.mono (fun y hy => deriv_deriv_shellTerm hτ hy)

theorem deriv_deriv_deriv_shellTerm {τ ξ x : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ)
    (hx : 0 < ξ ^ 2 + x) :
    deriv (deriv (deriv (shellTerm τ ξ))) x = -thirdKernel τ ξ x :=
  (hasDerivAt_deriv_deriv_shellTerm hτ hx).deriv

def thirdBound (τ ξ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  1 / (16 * τ ^ 2 * ξ ^ 3) + 3 / (16 * τ * ξ ^ 4) + 3 / (8 * ξ ^ 5)

theorem abs_tanh_le_one (z : ℝ) : |Real.tanh z| ≤ 1 := by
  have hc := Real.cosh_pos z
  have hs : |Real.sinh z| ≤ Real.cosh z := by
    have hrel := Real.cosh_sq_sub_sinh_sq z
    have habs := sq_abs (Real.sinh z)
    nlinarith [abs_nonneg (Real.sinh z)]
  rw [Real.tanh_eq_sinh_div_cosh, abs_div, abs_of_pos hc]
  exact (div_le_one hc).2 hs

theorem abs_tanh_div_cosh_sq_le_one (z : ℝ) :
    |Real.tanh z / Real.cosh z ^ 2| ≤ 1 := by
  have hc := Real.one_le_cosh z
  have hcp := Real.cosh_pos z
  rw [abs_div, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg (Real.cosh z))]
  apply (div_le_one (sq_pos_of_pos hcp)).2
  exact (abs_tanh_le_one z).trans (by nlinarith)

theorem abs_one_div_cosh_sq_le_one (z : ℝ) :
    |1 / Real.cosh z ^ 2| ≤ 1 := by
  have hc := Real.one_le_cosh z
  have hcp := Real.cosh_pos z
  rw [abs_of_pos (one_div_pos.2 (sq_pos_of_pos hcp))]
  exact (div_le_one (sq_pos_of_pos hcp)).2 (by nlinarith)

theorem abs_thirdKernel_le_energy_bound {τ ξ x : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ)
    (hx : 0 < ξ ^ 2 + x) :
    |thirdKernel τ ξ x| ≤ thirdBound τ (quasiparticleEnergy ξ x) := by
  let E := quasiparticleEnergy ξ x
  let z := E / (2 * τ)
  have hE : 0 < E := quasiparticleEnergy_pos hx
  let A := 1 / (16 * τ ^ 2 * E ^ 3)
  let B := 3 / (8 * E ^ 5)
  let C := 3 / (16 * τ * E ^ 4)
  have hA : 0 ≤ A := by dsimp [A]; positivity
  have hB : 0 ≤ B := by dsimp [B]; positivity
  have hC : 0 ≤ C := by dsimp [C]; positivity
  have heq : thirdKernel τ ξ x =
      (Real.tanh z / Real.cosh z ^ 2) * A - Real.tanh z * B +
        (1 / Real.cosh z ^ 2) * C := by
    dsimp [thirdKernel, A, B, C, z, E]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hτ, ne_of_gt (quasiparticleEnergy_pos hx),
      ne_of_gt (Real.cosh_pos (quasiparticleEnergy ξ x / (2 * τ)))]
    ring
  rw [heq]
  have hab : |(Real.tanh z / Real.cosh z ^ 2) * A - Real.tanh z * B| ≤
      |(Real.tanh z / Real.cosh z ^ 2) * A| + |Real.tanh z * B| := by
    simpa only [sub_zero, zero_sub, abs_neg] using
      (abs_sub_le ((Real.tanh z / Real.cosh z ^ 2) * A) 0 (Real.tanh z * B))
  calc
    |(Real.tanh z / Real.cosh z ^ 2) * A - Real.tanh z * B +
        (1 / Real.cosh z ^ 2) * C|
        ≤ |(Real.tanh z / Real.cosh z ^ 2) * A| + |Real.tanh z * B| +
            |(1 / Real.cosh z ^ 2) * C| :=
      (abs_add_le _ _).trans (add_le_add_right hab _)
    _ ≤ A + B + C := by
      simp only [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hA, abs_of_nonneg hB, abs_of_nonneg hC]
      exact add_le_add
        (add_le_add (by simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (abs_tanh_div_cosh_sq_le_one z) hA)
          (by simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (abs_tanh_le_one z) hB))
        (by simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (abs_one_div_cosh_sq_le_one z) hC)
    _ = thirdBound τ (quasiparticleEnergy ξ x) := by
      dsimp [A, B, C, E, thirdBound]
      ring

theorem thirdBound_antitone {τ ξ E : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hE : ξ ≤ E) :
    thirdBound τ E ≤ thirdBound τ ξ := by
  have h3 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hξ.le hE 3
  have h4 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hξ.le hE 4
  have h5 := pow_le_pow_left₀ hξ.le hE 5
  unfold thirdBound
  apply add_le_add
  · apply add_le_add
    · exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) (by positivity)
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h3 (by positivity))
    · exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) (by positivity)
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h4 (by positivity))
  · exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) (by positivity)
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h5 (by positivity))

theorem abs_thirdKernel_le {τ ξ x : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    |thirdKernel τ ξ x| ≤ thirdBound τ ξ := by
  have hr : 0 < ξ ^ 2 + x := by nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hξ]
  apply (abs_thirdKernel_le_energy_bound hτ hr).trans
  apply thirdBound_antitone hτ hξ
  exact Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le (by linarith)

theorem abs_thirdDerivative_le {τ x : ℝ} (ξ w : Shell → ℝ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : ∀ i, 0 < ξ i) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    |thirdDerivative τ ξ w x| ≤ ∑ i, |w i| * thirdBound τ (ξ i) := by
  unfold thirdDerivative
  apply (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _).trans
  apply Finset.sum_le_sum
  intro i _
  rw [abs_mul]
  exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (abs_thirdKernel_le hτ (hξ i) hx) (abs_nonneg _)

theorem abs_actual_thirdDerivative_le {τ g x : ℝ} (ξ w : Shell → ℝ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : ∀ i, 0 < ξ i) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    |deriv (deriv (deriv (freeEnergy τ g ξ w))) x| ≤
      ∑ i, |w i| * thirdBound τ (ξ i) := by
  rw [deriv_deriv_deriv_freeEnergy ξ w hτ
    (fun i => by nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos (hξ i)])]
  exact abs_thirdDerivative_le ξ w hτ hξ hx

end Superconductivity.BCSThirdDerivative
```

```lean
import Superconductivity.BCSBridge
import Superconductivity.BCSCurvature
import Superconductivity.BCSThirdDerivative
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Taylor
import Mathlib.Analysis.Convex.Deriv
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Sqrt
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Log.Deriv
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Deriv

/-!
# Controlled Taylor remainders for the finite BCS shell potential

The interval bound below is uniform in the expansion variable: for every fixed
`R > 0`, a single finite positive constant controls all `x ∈ [0,R]`.
The constant is obtained from smoothness and compactness, rather than supplied
as an assumption.  No numerical value or temperature-uniform bound is claimed.
-/

noncomputable section

open Set
open scoped BigOperators

namespace Superconductivity.BCSRemainder

open BCSBridge
open BCSCurvature
open BCSThirdDerivative

/-- The quasiparticle energy is smooth to every finite order away from its
square-root endpoint. The physical half-line is contained in this domain when
`ξ > 0`. -/
theorem contDiffAt_quasiparticleEnergy {n : WithTop ℕ∞} {ξ x : ℝ}
    (hx : 0 < ξ ^ 2 + x) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ n (quasiparticleEnergy ξ) x := by
  exact (contDiffAt_const.add contDiffAt_id).sqrt (ne_of_gt hx)

/-- Smoothness is proved from the actual logarithm, cosh, and square-root
composition, without assuming an expansion of the shell potential. -/
theorem contDiffAt_shellLog {n : WithTop ℕ∞} {τ ξ x : ℝ}
    (hx : 0 < ξ ^ 2 + x) : ContDiffAt ℝ n (shellLog τ ξ) x := by
  exact (((contDiffAt_quasiparticleEnergy hx).div_const (2 * τ)).cosh).log
    (ne_of_gt (Real.cosh_pos _))

theorem contDiffAt_shellTerm {n : WithTop ℕ∞} {τ ξ x : ℝ}
    (hx : 0 < ξ ^ 2 + x) : ContDiffAt ℝ n (shellTerm τ ξ) x := by
  exact contDiffAt_const.mul ((contDiffAt_shellLog hx).sub contDiffAt_const)

variable {Shell : Type*} [Fintype Shell]

theorem contDiffAt_freeEnergy {n : WithTop ℕ∞} {τ g x : ℝ}
    (ξ w : Shell → ℝ) (hx : ∀ i, 0 < ξ i ^ 2 + x) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ n (freeEnergy τ g ξ w) x := by
  exact (contDiffAt_id.div_const g).sub (ContDiffAt.sum
    (fun i (_hi : i ∈ Finset.univ) =>
      contDiffAt_const.mul (contDiffAt_shellTerm (hx i))))

/-- On the entire physical nonnegative intensity domain, all scalar shell
potentials are smooth provided the bare shell energies are strictly positive. -/
theorem contDiffOn_shellTerm {n : WithTop ℕ∞} {τ ξ : ℝ} (hξ : 0 < ξ) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ n (shellTerm τ ξ) (Ici 0) := by
  intro x hx
  exact (contDiffAt_shellTerm (add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg
    (sq_pos_of_pos hξ) hx)).contDiffWithinAt

theorem contDiffOn_freeEnergy {n : WithTop ℕ∞} {τ g : ℝ}
    (ξ w : Shell → ℝ) (hξ : ∀ i, 0 < ξ i) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ n (freeEnergy τ g ξ w) (Ici 0) := by
  intro x hx
  exact (contDiffAt_freeEnergy ξ w (fun i => add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg
    (sq_pos_of_pos (hξ i)) hx)).contDiffWithinAt

/-- On a nondegenerate interval, the second Taylor polynomial at zero uses the
actual unrestricted first and second derivatives whenever they are smooth there. -/
theorem taylor_two_eq {f : ℝ → ℝ} {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f 0) (x : ℝ) :
    taylorWithinEval f 2 (Icc 0 R) 0 x =
      f 0 + deriv f 0 * x + deriv (deriv f) 0 / 2 * x ^ 2 := by
  have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc 0 R := ⟨le_rfl, hR.le⟩
  have h1 : iteratedDerivWithin 1 f (Icc 0 R) 0 = deriv f 0 := by
    rw [iteratedDerivWithin_eq_iteratedDeriv (uniqueDiffOn_Icc hR)
      (hf.of_le (by norm_num)) h0, iteratedDeriv_one]
  have h2 : iteratedDerivWithin 2 f (Icc 0 R) 0 = deriv (deriv f) 0 := by
    rw [iteratedDerivWithin_eq_iteratedDeriv (uniqueDiffOn_Icc hR) hf h0]
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ (n := 1), iteratedDeriv_one]
  rw [taylorWithinEval_succ f 1 (Icc 0 R) 0 x,
    taylorWithinEval_succ f 0 (Icc 0 R) 0 x]
  simp only [taylor_within_zero_eval, Nat.cast_zero, zero_add, Nat.factorial_zero,
    Nat.cast_one, mul_one, inv_one, sub_zero, pow_one, one_mul, smul_eq_mul,
    Nat.factorial_one, h1, h2]
  ring

/-- A genuinely uniform cubic remainder obtained from actual `C³` regularity.
The hypotheses contain neither a remainder estimate nor a third-derivative bound. -/
theorem exists_uniform_cubic_remainder {f : ℝ → ℝ} {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R)
    (hf : ∀ x ∈ Icc 0 R, ContDiffAt ℝ 3 f x) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ x ∈ Icc 0 R,
      |f x - (f 0 + deriv f 0 * x + deriv (deriv f) 0 / 2 * x ^ 2)|
        ≤ C * x ^ 3 := by
  have hs : ContDiffOn ℝ 3 f (Icc 0 R) :=
    fun x hx => (hf x hx).contDiffWithinAt
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := exists_taylor_mean_remainder_bound (n := 2) hR.le hs
  refine ⟨max C 1, lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one (le_max_right _ _), ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  have hpoly := taylor_two_eq hR ((hf 0 ⟨le_rfl, hR.le⟩).of_le (by norm_num)) x
  have hb := hC x hx
  rw [hpoly] at hb
  simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sub_zero] at hb
  exact hb.trans (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_max_left _ _) (pow_nonneg hx.1 3))

/-- A controlled cubic remainder for the actual finite-shell log-cosh
potential, uniform over a prescribed bounded nonnegative intensity interval.
Since `shellTerm'' = -curvatureKernel`, the quartic energy coefficient has the
positive sign after subtracting the shell contribution in the BCS free energy. -/
theorem exists_shell_cubic_remainder {τ ξ R : ℝ}
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hR : 0 < R) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ x ∈ Icc 0 R,
      |shellTerm τ ξ x -
        (shellResponse τ ξ 0 * x - curvatureKernel τ ξ 0 / 2 * x ^ 2)|
        ≤ C * x ^ 3 := by
  obtain ⟨C, hCpos, hC⟩ := exists_uniform_cubic_remainder (f := shellTerm τ ξ) hR
    (fun x hx => contDiffAt_shellTerm
      (add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (sq_pos_of_pos hξ) hx.1))
  refine ⟨C, hCpos, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  have hzero : 0 < ξ ^ 2 + (0 : ℝ) := by simpa using sq_pos_of_pos hξ
  have hb := hC x hx
  rw [shellTerm_zero τ hξ.le, (hasDerivAt_shellTerm hτ hzero).deriv,
    deriv_deriv_shellTerm hτ hzero] at hb
  simpa only [zero_add, neg_div, neg_mul, sub_eq_add_neg] using hb

/-- The quadratic and quartic coefficients in this estimate are the actual
first and second derivatives of the same nonpolynomial BCS free energy. -/
theorem exists_freeEnergy_cubic_remainder {τ g R : ℝ}
    (ξ w : Shell → ℝ) (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : ∀ i, 0 < ξ i) (hR : 0 < R) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ x ∈ Icc 0 R,
      |freeEnergy τ g ξ w x -
        (gapResidual τ g ξ w 0 * x + curvature τ ξ w 0 / 2 * x ^ 2)|
        ≤ C * x ^ 3 := by
  obtain ⟨C, hCpos, hC⟩ := exists_uniform_cubic_remainder (f := freeEnergy τ g ξ w) hR
    (fun x hx => contDiffAt_freeEnergy ξ w
      (fun i => add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (sq_pos_of_pos (hξ i)) hx.1))
  refine ⟨C, hCpos, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  have hzero : ∀ i, 0 < ξ i ^ 2 + (0 : ℝ) :=
    fun i => by simpa using sq_pos_of_pos (hξ i)
  have hb := hC x hx
  simpa only [freeEnergy_zero τ g ξ w (fun i => (hξ i).le), zero_add,
    deriv_freeEnergy ξ w hτ hzero, deriv_deriv_freeEnergy ξ w hτ hzero] using hb

/-- The same uniform estimate expressed using the previously proved linear
pairing eigenvalue. The attraction must be nonzero to use this normalization. -/
theorem exists_freeEnergy_cubic_remainder_lambda {τ g R : ℝ}
    (ξ w : Shell → ℝ) (hτ : 0 < τ) (hg : g ≠ 0)
    (hξ : ∀ i, 0 < ξ i) (hR : 0 < R) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ x ∈ Icc 0 R,
      |freeEnergy τ g ξ w x -
        ((1 - pairingEigenvalue τ g ξ w) / g * x + curvature τ ξ w 0 / 2 * x ^ 2)|
        ≤ C * x ^ 3 := by
  have hzero : ∀ i, 0 < ξ i ^ 2 + (0 : ℝ) :=
    fun i => by simpa using sq_pos_of_pos (hξ i)
  have ha : gapResidual τ g ξ w 0 = (1 - pairingEigenvalue τ g ξ w) / g := by
    rw [← deriv_freeEnergy ξ w hτ hzero]
    exact (hasDerivAt_freeEnergy_zero_lambda ξ w hτ hg hξ).deriv
  simpa only [ha] using exists_freeEnergy_cubic_remainder (g := g) ξ w hτ hξ hR

/-- Strict concavity of the full shell potential is derived from its actual
negative second derivative. This statement concerns all nonnegative gap
intensities, rather than a truncated polynomial. -/
theorem strictConcaveOn_shellTerm {τ ξ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) :
    StrictConcaveOn ℝ (Ici 0) (shellTerm τ ξ) := by
  apply strictConcaveOn_of_deriv2_neg' (convex_Ici 0)
    (contDiffOn_shellTerm (n := 0) hξ).continuousOn
  intro x hx
  have hrad : 0 < ξ ^ 2 + x := add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (sq_pos_of_pos hξ) hx
  change deriv (deriv (shellTerm τ ξ)) x < 0
  rw [deriv_deriv_shellTerm hτ hrad]
  exact neg_lt_zero.mpr (curvatureKernel_pos hτ hrad)

/-- Convexity of the negative electronic shell energy, suitable for exact
Jensen comparisons in finite BCS models. -/
theorem strictConvexOn_neg_shellTerm {τ ξ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) :
    StrictConvexOn ℝ (Ici 0) (fun x => -shellTerm τ ξ x) := by
  exact (strictConcaveOn_shellTerm hτ hξ).neg

/-- Positive physical shell weights make the scalar BCS free energy strictly
convex as a function of the nonnegative gap intensity. This does not assert
existence of a minimizer or a thermodynamic phase transition. -/
theorem strictConvexOn_freeEnergy {τ g : ℝ} (ξ w : Shell → ℝ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : ∀ i, 0 < ξ i) (hw : ∀ i, 0 ≤ w i)
    (hwp : ∃ i, 0 < w i) :
    StrictConvexOn ℝ (Ici 0) (freeEnergy τ g ξ w) := by
  apply strictConvexOn_of_deriv2_pos' (convex_Ici 0)
    (contDiffOn_freeEnergy (n := 0) ξ w hξ).continuousOn
  intro x hx
  have hrad : ∀ i, 0 < ξ i ^ 2 + x :=
    fun i => add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (sq_pos_of_pos (hξ i)) hx
  change 0 < deriv (deriv (freeEnergy τ g ξ w)) x
  rw [deriv_deriv_freeEnergy ξ w hτ hrad]
  exact curvature_pos ξ w hτ hrad hw hwp

/-- The Lagrange form of Taylor's theorem, with the sharp factorial `3!` in
the estimate. This generic lemma is instantiated below using the explicitly
proved third derivatives of the actual BCS potential. -/
theorem cubic_remainder_le_of_third_derivative_bound {f : ℝ → ℝ} {M x : ℝ}
    (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hf : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ y → ContDiffAt ℝ 3 f y)
    (hM : ∀ y : ℝ, 0 ≤ y → |deriv (deriv (deriv f)) y| ≤ M) :
    |f x - (f 0 + deriv f 0 * x + deriv (deriv f) 0 / 2 * x ^ 2)|
      ≤ M / 6 * x ^ 3 := by
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hx with hzero | hxpos
  · rw [← hzero]
    simp
  have hs : ContDiffOn ℝ 3 f (Icc 0 x) :=
    fun y hy => (hf y hy.1).contDiffWithinAt
  obtain ⟨y, hy, he⟩ := taylor_mean_remainder_lagrange_iteratedDeriv (n := 2) hxpos hs
  rw [taylor_two_eq hxpos ((hf 0 le_rfl).of_le (by norm_num)) x] at he
  have h3 : iteratedDeriv 3 f y = deriv (deriv (deriv f)) y := by
    rw [iteratedDeriv_succ (n := 2), iteratedDeriv_succ (n := 1), iteratedDeriv_one]
  rw [h3] at he
  norm_num only [Nat.factorial, sub_zero] at he
  calc
    |f x - (f 0 + deriv f 0 * x + deriv (deriv f) 0 / 2 * x ^ 2)| =
        |deriv (deriv (deriv f)) y| * x ^ 3 / 6 := by
      rw [he, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg hx 3)]
      norm_num
    _ ≤ M * x ^ 3 / 6 :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hM y hy.1.le) (pow_nonneg hx 3)) (by norm_num)
    _ = M / 6 * x ^ 3 := by ring

/-- An explicit cubic shell remainder valid for every nonnegative intensity.
The coefficient is a closed expression in the positive temperature and bare
shell energy, rather than a compactness-selected constant. -/
theorem shell_remainder_le_explicit {τ ξ x : ℝ}
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    |shellTerm τ ξ x -
      (shellResponse τ ξ 0 * x - curvatureKernel τ ξ 0 / 2 * x ^ 2)|
      ≤ thirdBound τ ξ / 6 * x ^ 3 := by
  have hb := cubic_remainder_le_of_third_derivative_bound (f := shellTerm τ ξ) hx
    (fun y hy => contDiffAt_shellTerm
      (add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (sq_pos_of_pos hξ) hy))
    (fun y hy => by
      rw [deriv_deriv_deriv_shellTerm hτ
        (add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (sq_pos_of_pos hξ) hy), abs_neg]
      exact abs_thirdKernel_le hτ hξ hy)
  have hzero : 0 < ξ ^ 2 + (0 : ℝ) := by simpa using sq_pos_of_pos hξ
  rw [shellTerm_zero τ hξ.le, (hasDerivAt_shellTerm hτ hzero).deriv,
    deriv_deriv_shellTerm hτ hzero] at hb
  simpa only [zero_add, neg_div, neg_mul, sub_eq_add_neg] using hb

/-- An explicit error bound for the scalar finite BCS free energy, using its
actual first, second, and third derivatives. It is uniform over all `x ≥ 0`. -/
theorem freeEnergy_remainder_le_explicit {τ g x : ℝ}
    (ξ w : Shell → ℝ) (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : ∀ i, 0 < ξ i) (hx : 0 ≤ x) :
    |freeEnergy τ g ξ w x -
      (gapResidual τ g ξ w 0 * x + curvature τ ξ w 0 / 2 * x ^ 2)|
      ≤ (∑ i, |w i| * thirdBound τ (ξ i)) / 6 * x ^ 3 := by
  have hb := cubic_remainder_le_of_third_derivative_bound
    (f := freeEnergy τ g ξ w) hx
    (fun y hy => contDiffAt_freeEnergy ξ w
      (fun i => add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (sq_pos_of_pos (hξ i)) hy))
    (fun y hy => abs_actual_thirdDerivative_le ξ w hτ hξ hy)
  have hzero : ∀ i, 0 < ξ i ^ 2 + (0 : ℝ) :=
    fun i => by simpa using sq_pos_of_pos (hξ i)
  simpa only [freeEnergy_zero τ g ξ w (fun i => (hξ i).le), zero_add,
    deriv_freeEnergy ξ w hτ hzero, deriv_deriv_freeEnergy ξ w hτ hzero] using hb

end Superconductivity.BCSRemainder
```

```lean
import Mathlib.Data.Complex.Basic
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Fin
import Mathlib.Tactic.FinCases
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring

/-!
# A finite two-mode, four-shell pairing map

This module specifies the gap map `(z,w,z+w,z-w)` and strictly positive
shell weights `(4,4,1,1)`.  It proves exact quadratic and quartic identities
using the standard `Complex.normSq`.  These are algebraic identities, not a
claim that these shell data have been derived for any real material.

The midpoint equality criterion is also useful for a strictly convex shell
free energy: at fixed total intensity, both midpoint inequalities saturate
exactly on the two relative-phase branches `w = I*z` and `w = -I*z`.
-/

namespace Superconductivity.FourShell

open scoped BigOperators

def totalIntensity (z w : ℂ) : ℝ := Complex.normSq z + Complex.normSq w

def phasePenalty (z w : ℂ) : ℝ := Complex.normSq (z ^ 2 + w ^ 2)

def gap (z w : ℂ) : Fin 4 → ℂ := ![z, w, z + w, z - w]

def weight : Fin 4 → ℝ := ![4, 4, 1, 1]

theorem totalIntensity_nonneg (z w : ℂ) : 0 ≤ totalIntensity z w :=
  add_nonneg (Complex.normSq_nonneg z) (Complex.normSq_nonneg w)

theorem phasePenalty_nonneg (z w : ℂ) : 0 ≤ phasePenalty z w :=
  Complex.normSq_nonneg _

theorem weight_pos (j : Fin 4) : 0 < weight j := by
  fin_cases j <;> norm_num [weight]

theorem totalIntensity_eq_zero_iff (z w : ℂ) :
    totalIntensity z w = 0 ↔ z = 0 ∧ w = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hz := Complex.normSq_nonneg z
    have hw := Complex.normSq_nonneg w
    constructor
    · apply Complex.normSq_eq_zero.mp
      unfold totalIntensity at h
      linarith
    · apply Complex.normSq_eq_zero.mp
      unfold totalIntensity at h
      linarith
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    simp [totalIntensity]

theorem gap_eq_zero_iff (z w : ℂ) :
    (∀ j, gap z w j = 0) ↔ z = 0 ∧ w = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨by simpa [gap] using h 0, by simpa [gap] using h 1⟩
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [gap]

theorem gap_injective :
    Function.Injective (fun p : ℂ × ℂ => gap p.1 p.2) := by
  intro p q h
  apply Prod.ext
  · simpa [gap] using congrFun h 0
  · simpa [gap] using congrFun h 1

theorem exists_positive_weight_nonzero_gap (z w : ℂ)
    (h : z ≠ 0 ∨ w ≠ 0) :
    ∃ j, 0 < weight j ∧ gap z w j ≠ 0 := by
  rcases h with hz | hw
  · exact ⟨0, weight_pos 0, by simpa [gap] using hz⟩
  · exact ⟨1, weight_pos 1, by simpa [gap] using hw⟩

theorem midpoint_norm_identity (z w : ℂ) :
    Complex.normSq (z + w) + Complex.normSq (z - w) =
      2 * totalIntensity z w := by
  simp only [Complex.normSq_add, Complex.normSq_sub, totalIntensity]
  ring

theorem weighted_square_sum (z w : ℂ) :
    (∑ j, weight j * Complex.normSq (gap z w j)) =
      6 * totalIntensity z w := by
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_four]
  change 4 * Complex.normSq z + 4 * Complex.normSq w +
    1 * Complex.normSq (z + w) + 1 * Complex.normSq (z - w) = _
  simp only [one_mul, Complex.normSq_add, Complex.normSq_sub, totalIntensity]
  ring

theorem weighted_fourth_sum (z w : ℂ) :
    (∑ j, weight j * (Complex.normSq (gap z w j)) ^ 2) =
      4 * (totalIntensity z w) ^ 2 + 2 * phasePenalty z w := by
  simp only [Fin.sum_univ_four]
  change 4 * (Complex.normSq z) ^ 2 + 4 * (Complex.normSq w) ^ 2 +
    1 * (Complex.normSq (z + w)) ^ 2 + 1 * (Complex.normSq (z - w)) ^ 2 = _
  simp only [one_mul, totalIntensity, phasePenalty, Complex.normSq_apply,
    Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im,
    pow_two, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]
  ring

theorem phasePenalty_midpoint_decomposition (z w : ℂ) :
    4 * phasePenalty z w =
      4 * (Complex.normSq z - Complex.normSq w) ^ 2 +
        (Complex.normSq (z + w) - Complex.normSq (z - w)) ^ 2 := by
  simp only [phasePenalty, Complex.normSq_apply,
    Complex.add_re, Complex.add_im, Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im,
    pow_two, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]
  ring

theorem phasePenalty_zero_iff (z w : ℂ) :
    phasePenalty z w = 0 ↔ w = Complex.I * z ∨ w = -Complex.I * z := by
  have hfactor : z ^ 2 + w ^ 2 =
      (w - Complex.I * z) * (w + Complex.I * z) := by
    calc
      z ^ 2 + w ^ 2 = w ^ 2 - (Complex.I * z) ^ 2 := by
        rw [mul_pow, Complex.I_sq]
        ring
      _ = (w - Complex.I * z) * (w + Complex.I * z) := by ring
  rw [phasePenalty, Complex.normSq_eq_zero, hfactor, mul_eq_zero]
  simp only [sub_eq_zero, add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg, neg_mul]

theorem midpoint_equalities_iff_phase (z w : ℂ) :
    (Complex.normSq z = Complex.normSq w ∧
      Complex.normSq (z + w) = Complex.normSq (z - w)) ↔
      w = Complex.I * z ∨ w = -Complex.I * z := by
  rw [← phasePenalty_zero_iff]
  have hdec := phasePenalty_midpoint_decomposition z w
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hfirst, hsecond⟩
    rw [hfirst, hsecond] at hdec
    norm_num at hdec
    linarith
  · intro hzero
    rw [hzero] at hdec
    have hfirst := sq_nonneg (Complex.normSq z - Complex.normSq w)
    have hsecond := sq_nonneg
      (Complex.normSq (z + w) - Complex.normSq (z - w))
    constructor <;> nlinarith

theorem gap_normSq_le_twice_intensity (z w : ℂ) (j : Fin 4) :
    Complex.normSq (gap z w j) ≤ 2 * totalIntensity z w := by
  have hz := Complex.normSq_nonneg z
  have hw := Complex.normSq_nonneg w
  have hp := Complex.normSq_nonneg (z + w)
  have hm := Complex.normSq_nonneg (z - w)
  have hmid := midpoint_norm_identity z w
  fin_cases j
  · change Complex.normSq z ≤ 2 * totalIntensity z w
    unfold totalIntensity
    linarith
  · change Complex.normSq w ≤ 2 * totalIntensity z w
    unfold totalIntensity
    linarith
  · change Complex.normSq (z + w) ≤ 2 * totalIntensity z w
    linarith
  · change Complex.normSq (z - w) ≤ 2 * totalIntensity z w
    linarith

end Superconductivity.FourShell
```

```lean
import Superconductivity.FourShell
import Mathlib.Analysis.Convex.Function
import Mathlib.Data.Real.Sqrt
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum

/-!
# Exact fixed-intensity phase selection from a convex shell potential

This is a finite two-mode, four-shell model with gaps z,w,z+w,z-w and
weights 4,4,1,1. For any strictly convex scalar shell potential on [0,infinity),
we prove the complete fixed-total-intensity minimum classification.
`ChiralBCS` will supply that strict convexity from the actual BCS derivatives.
No thermodynamic limit, microscopic material symmetry or Maxwell energy is
part of this statement. The scalar coefficient of the quadratic cost can be arbitrary; the cost
is isotropic and is therefore constant on a fixed-intensity constraint.
-/

namespace Superconductivity.ConvexPhase

open FourShell

noncomputable section

/-- Two-point Jensen inequality in a convenient unweighted form. -/
theorem midpoint_le (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) f)
    (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    2 * f ((x + y) / 2) ≤ f x + f y := by
  have h := hf.2 hx hy (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 by norm_num)
    (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h
  have hid : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * x + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * y = (x + y) / 2 := by ring
  rw [hid] at h
  linarith

/-- Equality in two-point Jensen requires identical arguments. -/
theorem midpoint_eq_iff (f : ℝ → ℝ) (hf : StrictConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) f)
    (x y : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) :
    f x + f y = 2 * f ((x + y) / 2) ↔ x = y := by
  constructor
  · intro heq
    by_contra hxy
    have h := hf.2 hx hy hxy (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2 by norm_num)
      (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2 by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h
    have hid : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * x + (1 / 2 : ℝ) * y = (x + y) / 2 := by ring
    rw [hid] at h
    linarith
  · intro hxy
    rw [hxy]
    have hid : (y + y) / 2 = y := by ring
    rw [hid]
    ring

/-- The explicitly weighted four-shell energy, with isotropic quadratic cost. -/
def energy (a : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (z w : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  a * totalIntensity z w +
    (4 * f (Complex.normSq z) + 4 * f (Complex.normSq w) +
      f (Complex.normSq (z + w)) + f (Complex.normSq (z - w)))

/-- The exact radial minimum that will be attained by the relative phases plus or minus i. -/
def radialEnergy (a : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  a * s + 8 * f (s / 2) + 2 * f s

/-- Convexity bounds all complex mode pairs, not just a trial phase family. -/
theorem energy_lower_bound (a : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) f) (z w : ℂ) :
    radialEnergy a f (totalIntensity z w) ≤ energy a f z w := by
  have h₁ := midpoint_le f hf (Complex.normSq z) (Complex.normSq w)
    (Complex.normSq_nonneg z) (Complex.normSq_nonneg w)
  change 2 * f (totalIntensity z w / 2) ≤
    f (Complex.normSq z) + f (Complex.normSq w) at h₁
  have h₂ := midpoint_le f hf (Complex.normSq (z + w)) (Complex.normSq (z - w))
    (Complex.normSq_nonneg _) (Complex.normSq_nonneg _)
  have hid : (Complex.normSq (z + w) + Complex.normSq (z - w)) / 2 =
      totalIntensity z w := by
    rw [midpoint_norm_identity]
    ring
  rw [hid] at h₂
  unfold energy radialEnergy
  linarith

/-- Strict convexity makes the complete equality conditions equivalent to
relative phases plus or minus i, including the harmless zero-intensity case. -/
theorem energy_eq_bound_iff (a : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : StrictConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) f) (z w : ℂ) :
    energy a f z w = radialEnergy a f (totalIntensity z w) ↔
      w = Complex.I * z ∨ w = -Complex.I * z := by
  have h₁ := midpoint_le f hf.convexOn (Complex.normSq z) (Complex.normSq w)
    (Complex.normSq_nonneg z) (Complex.normSq_nonneg w)
  change 2 * f (totalIntensity z w / 2) ≤
    f (Complex.normSq z) + f (Complex.normSq w) at h₁
  have h₂ := midpoint_le f hf.convexOn (Complex.normSq (z + w)) (Complex.normSq (z - w))
    (Complex.normSq_nonneg _) (Complex.normSq_nonneg _)
  have hid : (Complex.normSq (z + w) + Complex.normSq (z - w)) / 2 =
      totalIntensity z w := by
    rw [midpoint_norm_identity]
    ring
  rw [hid] at h₂
  have he₁ := midpoint_eq_iff f hf (Complex.normSq z) (Complex.normSq w)
    (Complex.normSq_nonneg z) (Complex.normSq_nonneg w)
  change (f (Complex.normSq z) + f (Complex.normSq w) =
    2 * f (totalIntensity z w / 2) ↔ Complex.normSq z = Complex.normSq w) at he₁
  have he₂ := midpoint_eq_iff f hf (Complex.normSq (z + w)) (Complex.normSq (z - w))
    (Complex.normSq_nonneg _) (Complex.normSq_nonneg _)
  rw [hid] at he₂
  rw [← midpoint_equalities_iff_phase z w]
  constructor
  · intro heq
    unfold energy radialEnergy at heq
    exact ⟨he₁.mp (by linarith), he₂.mp (by linarith)⟩
  · rintro ⟨hz, hp⟩
    have e₁ := he₁.mpr hz
    have e₂ := he₂.mpr hp
    unfold energy radialEnergy
    linarith

/-- An explicit pair of equal-amplitude modes at prescribed intensity. -/
def firstMode (s : ℝ) : ℂ := (Real.sqrt (s / 2) : ℂ)

def secondMode (s : ℝ) : ℂ := Complex.I * firstMode s

theorem firstMode_normSq (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    Complex.normSq (firstMode s) = s / 2 := by
  exact (Complex.normSq_ofReal (Real.sqrt (s / 2))).trans
    (Real.mul_self_sqrt (div_nonneg hs (by norm_num)))

theorem secondMode_normSq (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    Complex.normSq (secondMode s) = s / 2 := by
  rw [secondMode, Complex.normSq_mul, Complex.normSq_I, one_mul, firstMode_normSq s hs]

theorem constructed_intensity (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    totalIntensity (firstMode s) (secondMode s) = s := by
  rw [totalIntensity, firstMode_normSq s hs, secondMode_normSq s hs]
  ring

theorem constructed_attains_bound (a : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : StrictConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) f) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    energy a f (firstMode s) (secondMode s) = radialEnergy a f s := by
  have h := (energy_eq_bound_iff a f hf (firstMode s) (secondMode s)).mpr (Or.inl rfl)
  rwa [constructed_intensity s hs] at h

/-- Fixed-intensity minimization is explicit about the constraint and quantifies
all complex pairs satisfying it. -/
def IsMinimizerAtIntensity (a : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (s : ℝ) (z w : ℂ) : Prop :=
  totalIntensity z w = s ∧
    ∀ z' w' : ℂ, totalIntensity z' w' = s → energy a f z w ≤ energy a f z' w'

/-- Complete exact phase classification for the original convex shell energy. -/
theorem fixed_intensity_minimizer_iff (a : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : StrictConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) f) (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (z w : ℂ) :
    IsMinimizerAtIntensity a f s z w ↔
      totalIntensity z w = s ∧ (w = Complex.I * z ∨ w = -Complex.I * z) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hzs, hmin⟩
    refine ⟨hzs, ?_⟩
    apply (energy_eq_bound_iff a f hf z w).mp
    have hle := hmin (firstMode s) (secondMode s) (constructed_intensity s hs)
    rw [constructed_attains_bound a f hf s hs] at hle
    rw [hzs]
    exact le_antisymm hle (by simpa [hzs] using energy_lower_bound a f hf.convexOn z w)
  · rintro ⟨hzs, hphase⟩
    refine ⟨hzs, ?_⟩
    intro z' w' hother
    rw [(energy_eq_bound_iff a f hf z w).mpr hphase, hzs, ← hother]
    exact energy_lower_bound a f hf.convexOn z' w'

/-- Positive prescribed intensity gives nonzero members of the constructed pair. -/
theorem constructed_both_nonzero (s : ℝ) (hs : 0 < s) :
    firstMode s ≠ 0 ∧ secondMode s ≠ 0 := by
  have hhalf : 0 < s / 2 := div_pos hs (by norm_num)
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hn := firstMode_normSq s (le_of_lt hs)
    rw [h, Complex.normSq_zero] at hn
    linarith
  · intro h
    have hn := secondMode_normSq s (le_of_lt hs)
    rw [h, Complex.normSq_zero] at hn
    linarith


/-- The remaining exact amplitude problem is one-dimensional. -/
def IsRadialMinimizer (a : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) (s : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 ≤ s ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → radialEnergy a f s ≤ radialEnergy a f t

/-- Exact reduction of the unconstrained two-complex-mode variational problem
into the proved phase branches and the remaining scalar radial minimum.
This equivalence does not assume or claim that a radial minimum exists. -/
theorem global_minimizer_iff (a : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ)
    (hf : StrictConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ici 0) f) (z w : ℂ) :
    (∀ z' w' : ℂ, energy a f z w ≤ energy a f z' w') ↔
      (w = Complex.I * z ∨ w = -Complex.I * z) ∧
        IsRadialMinimizer a f (totalIntensity z w) := by
  constructor
  · intro hmin
    have hs := totalIntensity_nonneg z w
    have hle := hmin (firstMode (totalIntensity z w)) (secondMode (totalIntensity z w))
    rw [constructed_attains_bound a f hf _ hs] at hle
    have heq : energy a f z w = radialEnergy a f (totalIntensity z w) :=
      le_antisymm hle (energy_lower_bound a f hf.convexOn z w)
    refine ⟨(energy_eq_bound_iff a f hf z w).mp heq, hs, ?_⟩
    intro t ht
    have h := hmin (firstMode t) (secondMode t)
    rwa [heq, constructed_attains_bound a f hf t ht] at h
  · rintro ⟨hphase, hs, hradial⟩ z' w'
    rw [(energy_eq_bound_iff a f hf z w).mpr hphase]
    exact le_trans (hradial _ (totalIntensity_nonneg z' w'))
      (energy_lower_bound a f hf.convexOn z' w')

end

end Superconductivity.ConvexPhase
```
