```lean
import Mathlib.Data.Complex.BigOperators
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.BigOperators.Ring.Finset
import Mathlib.Algebra.Star.BigOperators
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.BigOperators
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum

/-!
# Finite projected multicomponent quartic tensors

For a specified finite gap map `gap φ η j = ∑ a, φ j a * η a`, this
module proves its weighted quartic has an exact four-index tensor expansion.
`quartic` is the quartic coefficient form; the GL energy uses `quartic / 2`
when its shell coefficients are the actual BCS curvatures Ω''(0).

The coefficients and gap form factors are explicit inputs to this algebraic
module. Nonnegative coefficients give nonnegativity. Strict positivity on
nonzero mode vectors additionally requires the gap map to detect that vector.
No general interacting-Hamiltonian derivation or thermodynamic statement is
asserted here.
-/

open scoped BigOperators

noncomputable section

namespace Superconductivity.QuarticTensor

def intensity (z : ℂ) : ℝ := z.re ^ 2 + z.im ^ 2

theorem intensity_eq_normSq (z : ℂ) : intensity z = Complex.normSq z := by
  simp [intensity, Complex.normSq_apply, pow_two]

theorem intensity_nonneg (z : ℂ) : 0 ≤ intensity z := by
  unfold intensity
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg z.re, sq_nonneg z.im]

@[simp] theorem intensity_zero : intensity 0 = 0 := by
  simp [intensity]

theorem intensity_eq_zero_iff (z : ℂ) : intensity z = 0 ↔ z = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro hz
    have hre : z.re = 0 := by
      unfold intensity at hz
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg z.re, sq_nonneg z.im]
    have him : z.im = 0 := by
      unfold intensity at hz
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg z.re, sq_nonneg z.im]
    exact Complex.ext hre him
  · rintro rfl
    exact intensity_zero

theorem intensity_cast (z : ℂ) :
    (intensity z : ℂ) = star z * z := by
  rw [intensity_eq_normSq]
  exact Complex.normSq_eq_conj_mul_self

theorem intensity_mul (z w : ℂ) :
    intensity (z * w) = intensity z * intensity w := by
  simp [intensity, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]
  ring

theorem intensity_real_mul (t : ℝ) (z : ℂ) :
    intensity ((t : ℂ) * z) = t ^ 2 * intensity z := by
  simp [intensity, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]
  ring

variable {Shell Mode : Type*} [Fintype Mode]

def gap (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ) (η : Mode → ℂ) (j : Shell) : ℂ :=
  ∑ a, φ j a * η a

@[simp] theorem gap_zero (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ) (j : Shell) :
    gap φ (fun _ => 0) j = 0 := by
  simp [gap]

theorem gap_add (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ) (η ζ : Mode → ℂ) (j : Shell) :
    gap φ (fun a => η a + ζ a) j = gap φ η j + gap φ ζ j := by
  simp [gap, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

theorem gap_smul (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ) (η : Mode → ℂ)
    (u : ℂ) (j : Shell) :
    gap φ (fun a => u * η a) j = u * gap φ η j := by
  simp only [gap, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a ha
  ring

def totalIntensity (η : Mode → ℂ) : ℝ := ∑ a, intensity (η a)

/-- An explicit, generally nonoptimal, squared row-operator bound. -/
def rowBound (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ) (j : Shell) : ℝ :=
  (Fintype.card Mode : ℝ) * ∑ a, intensity (φ j a)

theorem totalIntensity_nonneg (η : Mode → ℂ) : 0 ≤ totalIntensity η := by
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun a ha => intensity_nonneg (η a)

theorem rowBound_nonneg (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ) (j : Shell) :
    0 ≤ rowBound φ j := by
  exact mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (Finset.sum_nonneg fun a ha =>
    intensity_nonneg (φ j a))

theorem intensity_le_totalIntensity (η : Mode → ℂ) (a : Mode) :
    intensity (η a) ≤ totalIntensity η := by
  exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun b hb => intensity_nonneg (η b))
    (Finset.mem_univ a)

theorem intensity_sum_le (v : Mode → ℂ) :
    intensity (∑ a, v a) ≤
      (Fintype.card Mode : ℝ) * ∑ a, intensity (v a) := by
  have hre : (∑ a, (v a).re) ^ 2 ≤
      (Fintype.card Mode : ℝ) * ∑ a, (v a).re ^ 2 := by
    simpa using Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq
      (Finset.univ : Finset Mode) (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (fun a => (v a).re)
  have him : (∑ a, (v a).im) ^ 2 ≤
      (Fintype.card Mode : ℝ) * ∑ a, (v a).im ^ 2 := by
    simpa using Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq
      (Finset.univ : Finset Mode) (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) (fun a => (v a).im)
  simpa only [intensity, Complex.re_sum, Complex.im_sum,
    Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_add] using add_le_add hre him

theorem gap_intensity_le (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ) (η : Mode → ℂ)
    (j : Shell) :
    intensity (gap φ η j) ≤ rowBound φ j * totalIntensity η := by
  have hprod : (∑ a, intensity (φ j a) * intensity (η a)) ≤
      (∑ a, intensity (φ j a)) * totalIntensity η := by
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro a ha
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (intensity_le_totalIntensity η a)
      (intensity_nonneg (φ j a))
  calc
    intensity (gap φ η j) ≤
        (Fintype.card Mode : ℝ) * ∑ a, intensity (φ j a * η a) := by
      exact intensity_sum_le (fun a => φ j a * η a)
    _ = (Fintype.card Mode : ℝ) *
        ∑ a, intensity (φ j a) * intensity (η a) := by
      simp only [intensity_mul]
    _ ≤ (Fintype.card Mode : ℝ) *
        ((∑ a, intensity (φ j a)) * totalIntensity η) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprod (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    _ = rowBound φ j * totalIntensity η := by
      unfold rowBound
      ring

variable [Fintype Shell]

def weightedIntensity (s : Shell → ℝ) (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ)
    (η : Mode → ℂ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j, s j * intensity (gap φ η j)

/-- This excludes the factor `1/2` appearing in the GL energy convention. -/
def quartic (q : Shell → ℝ) (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ)
    (η : Mode → ℂ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j, q j * intensity (gap φ η j) ^ 2

def gram (s : Shell → ℝ) (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ)
    (a b : Mode) : ℂ :=
  ∑ j, (s j : ℂ) * star (φ j a) * φ j b

def tensor (q : Shell → ℝ) (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ)
    (a b c d : Mode) : ℂ :=
  ∑ j, (q j : ℂ) * star (φ j a) * star (φ j b) * φ j c * φ j d

def quadraticContraction (C : Mode → Mode → ℂ) (η : Mode → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ p : Mode × Mode, star (η p.1) * C p.1 p.2 * η p.2

def quadraticCost (C : Mode → Mode → ℂ) (η : Mode → ℂ) : ℝ :=
  (quadraticContraction C η).re

def contraction (B : Mode → Mode → Mode → Mode → ℂ)
    (η : Mode → ℂ) : ℂ :=
  ∑ p : Mode × Mode × Mode × Mode,
    B p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2.1 p.2.2.2 *
      star (η p.1) * star (η p.2.1) * η p.2.2.1 * η p.2.2.2

theorem contraction_eq_nested (B : Mode → Mode → Mode → Mode → ℂ)
    (η : Mode → ℂ) :
    contraction B η = ∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ c, ∑ d,
      B a b c d * star (η a) * star (η b) * η c * η d := by
  simp [contraction, Fintype.sum_prod_type]

omit [Fintype Mode] in
theorem tensor_swap_first (q : Shell → ℝ) (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ)
    (a b c d : Mode) : tensor q φ a b c d = tensor q φ b a c d := by
  unfold tensor
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  ring

omit [Fintype Mode] in
theorem tensor_swap_last (q : Shell → ℝ) (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ)
    (a b c d : Mode) : tensor q φ a b c d = tensor q φ a b d c := by
  unfold tensor
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  ring

omit [Fintype Mode] in
theorem tensor_conjugate_exchange (q : Shell → ℝ)
    (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ) (a b c d : Mode) :
    star (tensor q φ a b c d) = tensor q φ c d a b := by
  simp only [tensor, star_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  simp only [star_mul, star_star]
  have hq : star (q j : ℂ) = (q j : ℂ) := Complex.conj_ofReal (q j)
  rw [hq]
  ring

omit [Fintype Mode] in
theorem gram_hermitian (s : Shell → ℝ) (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ)
    (a b : Mode) : star (gram s φ a b) = gram s φ b a := by
  simp only [gram, star_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  simp only [star_mul, star_star]
  have hs : star (s j : ℂ) = (s j : ℂ) := Complex.conj_ofReal (s j)
  rw [hs]
  ring

theorem rankOne_contraction (v η : Mode → ℂ) :
    contraction (fun a b c d => star (v a) * star (v b) * v c * v d) η =
      (intensity (∑ a, v a * η a) : ℂ) ^ 2 := by
  rw [intensity_cast]
  simp only [contraction_eq_nested, star_sum, star_mul]
  calc
    (∑ a, ∑ b, ∑ c, ∑ d,
      (star (v a) * star (v b) * v c * v d) *
        star (η a) * star (η b) * η c * η d) =
      (∑ d, v d * η d) * (∑ c, v c * η c) *
        (∑ b, star (v b * η b)) * (∑ a, star (v a * η a)) := by
          simp only [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum, star_mul]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro a ha
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro b hb
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro c hc
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro d hd
          ring
    _ = ((∑ a, star (v a * η a)) * (∑ a, v a * η a)) ^ 2 := by ring
    _ = _ := by simp only [star_mul]

theorem contraction_smul (B : Mode → Mode → Mode → Mode → ℂ)
    (η : Mode → ℂ) (r : ℂ) :
    contraction (fun a b c d => r * B a b c d) η = r * contraction B η := by
  simp only [contraction, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro p hp
  ring

theorem contraction_sum (B : Shell → Mode → Mode → Mode → Mode → ℂ)
    (η : Mode → ℂ) :
    contraction (fun a b c d => ∑ j, B j a b c d) η =
      ∑ j, contraction (B j) η := by
  simp only [contraction, Finset.sum_mul]
  exact Finset.sum_comm

theorem contraction_tensor (q : Shell → ℝ) (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ)
    (η : Mode → ℂ) :
    contraction (tensor q φ) η = (quartic q φ η : ℂ) := by
  calc
    contraction (tensor q φ) η =
      contraction (fun a b c d => ∑ j, (q j : ℂ) *
        (star (φ j a) * star (φ j b) * φ j c * φ j d)) η := by
          congr 1
          funext a b c d
          unfold tensor
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j hj
          ring
    _ = ∑ j, (q j : ℂ) * (intensity (gap φ η j) : ℂ) ^ 2 := by
      rw [contraction_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      rw [contraction_smul, rankOne_contraction]
      rfl
    _ = (quartic q φ η : ℂ) := by
      simp [quartic]

theorem contraction_tensor_real (q : Shell → ℝ) (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ)
    (η : Mode → ℂ) :
    (contraction (tensor q φ) η).re = quartic q φ η := by
  rw [contraction_tensor]
  rfl

theorem contraction_tensor_im_zero (q : Shell → ℝ) (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ)
    (η : Mode → ℂ) :
    (contraction (tensor q φ) η).im = 0 := by
  rw [contraction_tensor]
  rfl

theorem rankOne_quadraticContraction (v η : Mode → ℂ) :
    quadraticContraction (fun a b => star (v a) * v b) η =
      (intensity (∑ a, v a * η a) : ℂ) := by
  rw [intensity_cast]
  simp only [star_sum, star_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum]
  simp only [quadraticContraction, Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a ha
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro b hb
  ring

theorem quadraticContraction_smul (C : Mode → Mode → ℂ)
    (η : Mode → ℂ) (r : ℂ) :
    quadraticContraction (fun a b => r * C a b) η =
      r * quadraticContraction C η := by
  simp only [quadraticContraction, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro p hp
  ring

theorem quadraticContraction_sum (C : Shell → Mode → Mode → ℂ)
    (η : Mode → ℂ) :
    quadraticContraction (fun a b => ∑ j, C j a b) η =
      ∑ j, quadraticContraction (C j) η := by
  simp only [quadraticContraction, Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_comm

theorem quadraticContraction_gram (s : Shell → ℝ)
    (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ) (η : Mode → ℂ) :
    quadraticContraction (gram s φ) η = (weightedIntensity s φ η : ℂ) := by
  calc
    quadraticContraction (gram s φ) η =
      quadraticContraction (fun a b => ∑ j,
        (s j : ℂ) * (star (φ j a) * φ j b)) η := by
          congr 1
          funext a b
          unfold gram
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j hj
          ring
    _ = ∑ j, (s j : ℂ) * (intensity (gap φ η j) : ℂ) := by
      rw [quadraticContraction_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      rw [quadraticContraction_smul, rankOne_quadraticContraction]
      rfl
    _ = (weightedIntensity s φ η : ℂ) := by
      simp [weightedIntensity]

theorem quadraticCost_gram (s : Shell → ℝ) (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ)
    (η : Mode → ℂ) :
    quadraticCost (gram s φ) η = weightedIntensity s φ η := by
  unfold quadraticCost
  rw [quadraticContraction_gram]
  rfl

theorem quadraticCost_sub (C D : Mode → Mode → ℂ) (η : Mode → ℂ) :
    quadraticCost (fun a b => C a b - D a b) η =
      quadraticCost C η - quadraticCost D η := by
  simp [quadraticCost, quadraticContraction, mul_sub, sub_mul,
    Finset.sum_sub_distrib]

theorem projected_quadratic_identity (C : Mode → Mode → ℂ)
    (s : Shell → ℝ) (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ) (η : Mode → ℂ) :
    quadraticCost (fun a b => C a b - gram s φ a b) η =
      quadraticCost C η - weightedIntensity s φ η := by
  rw [quadraticCost_sub, quadraticCost_gram]

theorem quartic_nonneg (q : Shell → ℝ) (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ)
    (η : Mode → ℂ) (hq : ∀ j, 0 ≤ q j) : 0 ≤ quartic q φ η := by
  unfold quartic
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro j hj
  exact mul_nonneg (hq j) (sq_nonneg _)

@[simp] theorem quartic_zero (q : Shell → ℝ) (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ) :
    quartic q φ (fun _ => 0) = 0 := by
  simp [quartic]

theorem quartic_eq_zero_iff (q : Shell → ℝ) (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ)
    (η : Mode → ℂ) (hq : ∀ j, 0 ≤ q j) :
    quartic q φ η = 0 ↔ ∀ j, 0 < q j → gap φ η j = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h j hjpos
    have hterm : q j * intensity (gap φ η j) ^ 2 ≤ quartic q φ η := by
      unfold quartic
      exact Finset.single_le_sum
        (fun k hk => mul_nonneg (hq k) (sq_nonneg (intensity (gap φ η k))))
        (Finset.mem_univ j)
    have hprod : q j * intensity (gap φ η j) ^ 2 = 0 := by
      have hn := mul_nonneg (hq j) (sq_nonneg (intensity (gap φ η j)))
      linarith
    have hsq : intensity (gap φ η j) ^ 2 = 0 :=
      (mul_eq_zero.mp hprod).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hjpos)
    apply (intensity_eq_zero_iff _).mp
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (intensity (gap φ η j))]
  · intro h
    unfold quartic
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro j hj
    by_cases hqj : q j = 0
    · simp [hqj]
    · have hjpos : 0 < q j := lt_of_le_of_ne (hq j) (Ne.symm hqj)
      simp [h j hjpos]

theorem quartic_pos_of_injective (q : Shell → ℝ)
    (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ) (η : Mode → ℂ)
    (hq : ∀ j, 0 < q j) (hinj : Function.Injective (gap φ))
    (hη : η ≠ fun _ => 0) : 0 < quartic q φ η := by
  have hn := quartic_nonneg q φ η (fun j => le_of_lt (hq j))
  have hne : quartic q φ η ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have hall := (quartic_eq_zero_iff q φ η (fun j => le_of_lt (hq j))).mp hz
    apply hη
    apply hinj
    funext j
    rw [hall j (hq j), gap_zero]
  exact lt_of_le_of_ne hn (Ne.symm hne)

theorem quartic_real_scale (q : Shell → ℝ) (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ)
    (η : Mode → ℂ) (t : ℝ) :
    quartic q φ (fun a => (t : ℂ) * η a) = t ^ 4 * quartic q φ η := by
  simp only [quartic, gap_smul, intensity_real_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  ring

theorem quartic_unit_phase (q : Shell → ℝ) (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ)
    (η : Mode → ℂ) (u : ℂ) (hu : intensity u = 1) :
    quartic q φ (fun a => u * η a) = quartic q φ η := by
  simp [quartic, gap_smul, intensity_mul, hu]

theorem single_mode_reduction (q : Shell → ℝ) (z : ℂ) :
    quartic q (fun (_ : Shell) (_ : Unit) => (1 : ℂ)) (fun _ => z) =
      (∑ j, q j) * intensity z ^ 2 := by
  simp [quartic, gap, Finset.sum_mul]

def cancellationMode (a : Bool) : ℂ := if a then 1 else -1

theorem cancellationMode_nonzero : cancellationMode ≠ fun _ => 0 := by
  intro h
  have ht := congrFun h true
  norm_num [cancellationMode] at ht

theorem duplicate_columns_zero_gap :
    gap (fun (_ : Unit) (_ : Bool) => (1 : ℂ)) cancellationMode () = 0 := by
  simp [gap, cancellationMode]

theorem positive_coefficients_can_have_null_direction :
    quartic (fun (_ : Unit) => (1 : ℝ))
      (fun (_ : Unit) (_ : Bool) => (1 : ℂ)) cancellationMode = 0 ∧
      cancellationMode ≠ fun _ => 0 := by
  constructor
  · simp [quartic, gap, cancellationMode, intensity]
  · exact cancellationMode_nonzero

end Superconductivity.QuarticTensor
```

```lean
import Superconductivity.QuarticTensor
import Superconductivity.BCSCurvature

/-!
# One finite BCS potential and its projected quadratic / quartic forms

This is a specified finite mean-field ansatz with shell-dependent complex gaps
`Δ_j(η) = ∑ a, φ j a * η a`. Its quadratic pairing cost is the real part of
`η† C η`; a physical Hermitian cost matrix is supplied rather than derived from
a generic interacting Hamiltonian. Nothing here asserts global boundedness of
the original potential for arbitrary `C`.

The quartic coefficient tensor is obtained by inserting the actual shell BCS
curvature into `QuarticTensor.tensor`. The GL energy includes the factor `1/2`.
The exact residual identity exposes the input needed for a controlled Taylor
remainder bound, without assuming the bound as a definition of the energy.
-/

noncomputable section

open scoped BigOperators

namespace Superconductivity.MultiGapBCS

open QuarticTensor

variable {Shell Mode : Type*} [Fintype Shell] [Fintype Mode]

def freeEnergy (τ : ℝ) (ξ w : Shell → ℝ) (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ)
    (C : Mode → Mode → ℂ) (η : Mode → ℂ) : ℝ :=
  quadraticCost C η -
    ∑ j, w j * BCSBridge.shellTerm τ (ξ j) (intensity (gap φ η j))

def susceptibilityWeights (τ : ℝ) (ξ w : Shell → ℝ) (j : Shell) : ℝ :=
  w j * BCSBridge.shellResponse τ (ξ j) 0

def curvatureWeights (τ : ℝ) (ξ w : Shell → ℝ) (j : Shell) : ℝ :=
  w j * BCSCurvature.curvatureKernel τ (ξ j) 0

def quadraticMatrix (τ : ℝ) (ξ w : Shell → ℝ) (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ)
    (C : Mode → Mode → ℂ) (a b : Mode) : ℂ :=
  C a b - gram (susceptibilityWeights τ ξ w) φ a b

def glEnergy (τ : ℝ) (ξ w : Shell → ℝ) (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ)
    (C : Mode → Mode → ℂ) (η : Mode → ℂ) : ℝ :=
  quadraticCost (quadraticMatrix τ ξ w φ C) η +
    quartic (curvatureWeights τ ξ w) φ η / 2

def shellRemainder (τ ξ x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  BCSBridge.shellTerm τ ξ x - BCSBridge.shellResponse τ ξ 0 * x +
    BCSCurvature.curvatureKernel τ ξ 0 * x ^ 2 / 2

omit [Fintype Mode] in
theorem quadraticMatrix_hermitian (τ : ℝ) (ξ w : Shell → ℝ)
    (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ) (C : Mode → Mode → ℂ)
    (hC : ∀ a b, star (C a b) = C b a) (a b : Mode) :
    star (quadraticMatrix τ ξ w φ C a b) =
      quadraticMatrix τ ξ w φ C b a := by
  simp only [quadraticMatrix, star_sub, hC, gram_hermitian]

theorem glEnergy_eq_shell_polynomial (τ : ℝ) (ξ w : Shell → ℝ)
    (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ) (C : Mode → Mode → ℂ) (η : Mode → ℂ) :
    glEnergy τ ξ w φ C η = quadraticCost C η -
      ∑ j, w j * BCSBridge.shellResponse τ (ξ j) 0 * intensity (gap φ η j) +
      (∑ j, w j * BCSCurvature.curvatureKernel τ (ξ j) 0 *
        intensity (gap φ η j) ^ 2) / 2 := by
  unfold glEnergy quadraticMatrix
  rw [projected_quadratic_identity]
  rfl

theorem glEnergy_eq_tensor (τ : ℝ) (ξ w : Shell → ℝ)
    (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ) (C : Mode → Mode → ℂ) (η : Mode → ℂ) :
    glEnergy τ ξ w φ C η =
      quadraticCost (quadraticMatrix τ ξ w φ C) η +
      (contraction (tensor (curvatureWeights τ ξ w) φ) η).re / 2 := by
  rw [contraction_tensor_real]
  rfl

theorem freeEnergy_sub_glEnergy (τ : ℝ) (ξ w : Shell → ℝ)
    (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ) (C : Mode → Mode → ℂ) (η : Mode → ℂ) :
    freeEnergy τ ξ w φ C η - glEnergy τ ξ w φ C η =
      -(∑ j, w j * shellRemainder τ (ξ j) (intensity (gap φ η j))) := by
  rw [glEnergy_eq_shell_polynomial]
  unfold freeEnergy shellRemainder
  simp only [mul_add, mul_sub, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    div_eq_mul_inv]
  simp_rw [← mul_assoc]
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
  ring

theorem shellRemainder_eq_taylor_form (τ ξ x : ℝ) :
    shellRemainder τ ξ x = BCSBridge.shellTerm τ ξ x -
      (BCSBridge.shellResponse τ ξ 0 * x -
        BCSCurvature.curvatureKernel τ ξ 0 / 2 * x ^ 2) := by
  unfold shellRemainder
  ring

omit [Fintype Shell] in
theorem curvatureWeights_nonneg {τ : ℝ} (ξ w : Shell → ℝ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : ∀ j, 0 < ξ j) (hw : ∀ j, 0 ≤ w j) (j : Shell) :
    0 ≤ curvatureWeights τ ξ w j := by
  exact mul_nonneg (hw j) (le_of_lt (BCSCurvature.curvatureKernel_pos hτ
    (by simpa using sq_pos_of_pos (hξ j))))

omit [Fintype Shell] in
theorem curvatureWeights_pos {τ : ℝ} (ξ w : Shell → ℝ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : ∀ j, 0 < ξ j) (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j) (j : Shell) :
    0 < curvatureWeights τ ξ w j := by
  exact mul_pos (hw j) (BCSCurvature.curvatureKernel_pos hτ
    (by simpa using sq_pos_of_pos (hξ j)))

theorem derived_quartic_nonneg {τ : ℝ} (ξ w : Shell → ℝ)
    (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ) (η : Mode → ℂ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : ∀ j, 0 < ξ j) (hw : ∀ j, 0 ≤ w j) :
    0 ≤ quartic (curvatureWeights τ ξ w) φ η := by
  exact quartic_nonneg _ φ η (curvatureWeights_nonneg ξ w hτ hξ hw)

theorem derived_quartic_pos_of_injective {τ : ℝ} (ξ w : Shell → ℝ)
    (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ) (η : Mode → ℂ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : ∀ j, 0 < ξ j) (hw : ∀ j, 0 < w j)
    (hinj : Function.Injective (gap φ)) (hη : η ≠ fun _ => 0) :
    0 < quartic (curvatureWeights τ ξ w) φ η := by
  exact quartic_pos_of_injective _ φ η
    (curvatureWeights_pos ξ w hτ hξ hw) hinj hη

theorem freeEnergy_zero (τ : ℝ) (ξ w : Shell → ℝ)
    (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ) (C : Mode → Mode → ℂ)
    (hξ : ∀ j, 0 ≤ ξ j) :
    freeEnergy τ ξ w φ C (fun _ => 0) = 0 := by
  simp [freeEnergy, quadraticCost, quadraticContraction,
    BCSBridge.shellTerm_zero τ (hξ _)]

theorem single_mode_freeEnergy (τ g : ℝ) (ξ w : Shell → ℝ) (z : ℂ) :
    freeEnergy τ ξ w (fun (_ : Shell) (_ : Unit) => (1 : ℂ))
      (fun (_ _ : Unit) => ((1 / g : ℝ) : ℂ)) (fun _ => z) =
      BCSBridge.freeEnergy τ g ξ w (intensity z) := by
  have hcost : quadraticCost (fun (_ _ : Unit) => ((1 / g : ℝ) : ℂ))
      (fun _ => z) = intensity z / g := by
    simp [quadraticCost, quadraticContraction, intensity, Complex.mul_re,
      Complex.mul_im]
    ring
  simp only [freeEnergy, hcost, BCSBridge.freeEnergy]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j hj
  simp [gap]

end Superconductivity.MultiGapBCS
```

```lean
import Superconductivity.ConvexPhase
import Superconductivity.BCSRemainder
import Superconductivity.MultiGapBCS

/-!
# From one finite BCS potential to derived chiral coefficients and exact phases

The shell map is z,w,z+w,z-w, with weights 4,4,1,1, a common positive bare
shell energy and temperature, and isotropic pairing cost (|z|^2+|w|^2)/g.
The coefficient of the phase-sensitive quartic is the actual positive BCS
shell curvature, not an independent postulate. More strongly, strict convexity
of the original negative shell potential selects the same relative phases
at every prescribed total intensity, with an exact radial reduction.

The result is for this specified finite mean-field ansatz. It does not derive
the shell data of any material, electromagnetic response, or a thermodynamic
phase transition. The symmetry interpretation requires the displayed real
mode basis; no material-specific time-reversal claim is made here.
-/

noncomputable section

open scoped BigOperators

namespace Superconductivity.ChiralBCS

open BCSBridge BCSCurvature

/-- The real finite pairing basis, written as a complex matrix. -/
def basis : Fin 4 → Fin 2 → ℂ := ![![1, 0], ![0, 1], ![1, 1], ![1, -1]]

def modes (z w : ℂ) : Fin 2 → ℂ := ![z, w]

def costMatrix (g : ℝ) : Fin 2 → Fin 2 → ℂ :=
  ![![((1 / g : ℝ) : ℂ), 0], ![0, ((1 / g : ℝ) : ℂ)]]

/-- Original, nonpolynomial free energy, including its normal-state subtraction. -/
def energy (τ ξ g : ℝ) (z w : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  FourShell.totalIntensity z w / g -
    ∑ j, FourShell.weight j * shellTerm τ ξ (Complex.normSq (FourShell.gap z w j))

/-- Exact one-dimensional energy after minimizing the complex mode direction. -/
def radialEnergy (τ ξ g s : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  s / g - 8 * shellTerm τ ξ (s / 2) - 2 * shellTerm τ ξ s

def quadraticCoefficient (τ ξ g : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  1 / g - 6 * shellResponse τ ξ 0

/-- GL polynomial with all quadratic and quartic coefficients matched to the
same finite BCS potential. The quartic ratio is derived, not freely chosen. -/
def glEnergy (τ ξ g : ℝ) (z w : ℂ) : ℝ :=
  quadraticCoefficient τ ξ g * FourShell.totalIntensity z w +
    2 * curvatureKernel τ ξ 0 * (FourShell.totalIntensity z w) ^ 2 +
    curvatureKernel τ ξ 0 * FourShell.phasePenalty z w

theorem basis_gap (z w : ℂ) (j : Fin 4) :
    QuarticTensor.gap basis (modes z w) j = FourShell.gap z w j := by
  fin_cases j <;> simp [QuarticTensor.gap, basis, modes, FourShell.gap, Fin.sum_univ_two,
    sub_eq_add_neg]

theorem modes_intensity (z w : ℂ) :
    QuarticTensor.totalIntensity (modes z w) = FourShell.totalIntensity z w := by
  simp [QuarticTensor.totalIntensity, QuarticTensor.intensity_eq_normSq,
    modes, Fin.sum_univ_two, FourShell.totalIntensity]

theorem costMatrix_hermitian (g : ℝ) (a b : Fin 2) :
    star (costMatrix g a b) = costMatrix g b a := by
  fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> simp [costMatrix]

theorem quadraticCost_modes (g : ℝ) (z w : ℂ) :
    QuarticTensor.quadraticCost (costMatrix g) (modes z w) =
      FourShell.totalIntensity z w / g := by
  simp [QuarticTensor.quadraticCost, QuarticTensor.quadraticContraction,
    Fintype.sum_prod_type, costMatrix, modes, Fin.sum_univ_two, FourShell.totalIntensity,
    Complex.normSq_apply, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im]
  ring

/-- This example is literally an instance of the general finite multigap potential. -/
theorem energy_matches_multigap (τ ξ g : ℝ) (z w : ℂ) :
    energy τ ξ g z w = MultiGapBCS.freeEnergy τ (fun _ => ξ) FourShell.weight
      basis (costMatrix g) (modes z w) := by
  simp only [MultiGapBCS.freeEnergy, quadraticCost_modes, basis_gap,
    QuarticTensor.intensity_eq_normSq]
  rfl

/-- Exact conversion to the convex shell-potential variational problem. -/
theorem energy_eq_convex (τ ξ g : ℝ) (z w : ℂ) :
    energy τ ξ g z w = ConvexPhase.energy (1 / g)
      (fun x => -shellTerm τ ξ x) z w := by
  unfold energy
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_four]
  change FourShell.totalIntensity z w / g -
      (4 * shellTerm τ ξ (Complex.normSq z) + 4 * shellTerm τ ξ (Complex.normSq w) +
       1 * shellTerm τ ξ (Complex.normSq (z + w)) +
       1 * shellTerm τ ξ (Complex.normSq (z - w))) = _
  unfold ConvexPhase.energy
  ring

theorem radialEnergy_eq_convex (τ ξ g s : ℝ) :
    radialEnergy τ ξ g s = ConvexPhase.radialEnergy (1 / g)
      (fun x => -shellTerm τ ξ x) s := by
  unfold radialEnergy ConvexPhase.radialEnergy
  ring

/-- An exact lower bound for the original BCS free energy at its given intensity. -/
theorem energy_lower_bound {τ ξ : ℝ} (g : ℝ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (z w : ℂ) :
    radialEnergy τ ξ g (FourShell.totalIntensity z w) ≤ energy τ ξ g z w := by
  rw [energy_eq_convex, radialEnergy_eq_convex]
  exact ConvexPhase.energy_lower_bound (1 / g) _
    (BCSRemainder.strictConvexOn_neg_shellTerm hτ hξ).convexOn z w

/-- The two phase branches minimize the full nonpolynomial energy, not merely
its GL truncation. This is an equality condition at fixed total intensity. -/
theorem energy_eq_bound_iff {τ ξ : ℝ} (g : ℝ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (z w : ℂ) :
    energy τ ξ g z w = radialEnergy τ ξ g (FourShell.totalIntensity z w) ↔
      w = Complex.I * z ∨ w = -Complex.I * z := by
  rw [energy_eq_convex, radialEnergy_eq_convex]
  exact ConvexPhase.energy_eq_bound_iff (1 / g) _
    (BCSRemainder.strictConvexOn_neg_shellTerm hτ hξ) z w

/-- All complex configurations at a prescribed intensity are compared. -/
theorem fixed_intensity_minimizer_iff {τ ξ : ℝ} (g s : ℝ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) (z w : ℂ) :
    (FourShell.totalIntensity z w = s ∧
      ∀ z' w' : ℂ, FourShell.totalIntensity z' w' = s →
        energy τ ξ g z w ≤ energy τ ξ g z' w') ↔
    FourShell.totalIntensity z w = s ∧
      (w = Complex.I * z ∨ w = -Complex.I * z) := by
  simp only [energy_eq_convex]
  exact ConvexPhase.fixed_intensity_minimizer_iff (1 / g) _
    (BCSRemainder.strictConvexOn_neg_shellTerm hτ hξ) s hs z w

theorem constructed_attains_bound {τ ξ : ℝ} (g s : ℝ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    energy τ ξ g (ConvexPhase.firstMode s) (ConvexPhase.secondMode s) =
      radialEnergy τ ξ g s := by
  rw [energy_eq_convex, radialEnergy_eq_convex]
  exact ConvexPhase.constructed_attains_bound (1 / g) _
    (BCSRemainder.strictConvexOn_neg_shellTerm hτ hξ) s hs

def IsRadialMinimizer (τ ξ g s : ℝ) : Prop :=
  0 ≤ s ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → radialEnergy τ ξ g s ≤ radialEnergy τ ξ g t

/-- Complete variational reduction; radial existence is not assumed here. -/
theorem global_minimizer_iff {τ ξ : ℝ} (g : ℝ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (z w : ℂ) :
    (∀ z' w' : ℂ, energy τ ξ g z w ≤ energy τ ξ g z' w') ↔
      (w = Complex.I * z ∨ w = -Complex.I * z) ∧
        IsRadialMinimizer τ ξ g (FourShell.totalIntensity z w) := by
  simp only [energy_eq_convex, IsRadialMinimizer, radialEnergy_eq_convex]
  exact ConvexPhase.global_minimizer_iff (1 / g) _
    (BCSRemainder.strictConvexOn_neg_shellTerm hτ hξ) z w

theorem weighted_response_sum (τ ξ : ℝ) (z w : ℂ) :
    (∑ j, FourShell.weight j * shellResponse τ ξ 0 *
      Complex.normSq (FourShell.gap z w j)) =
      shellResponse τ ξ 0 * (6 * FourShell.totalIntensity z w) := by
  calc
    _ = shellResponse τ ξ 0 *
        (∑ j, FourShell.weight j * Complex.normSq (FourShell.gap z w j)) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      ring
    _ = _ := by rw [FourShell.weighted_square_sum]

theorem weighted_curvature_sum (τ ξ : ℝ) (z w : ℂ) :
    (∑ j, FourShell.weight j * curvatureKernel τ ξ 0 *
      (Complex.normSq (FourShell.gap z w j)) ^ 2) =
      curvatureKernel τ ξ 0 *
        (4 * (FourShell.totalIntensity z w) ^ 2 + 2 * FourShell.phasePenalty z w) := by
  calc
    _ = curvatureKernel τ ξ 0 *
        (∑ j, FourShell.weight j * (Complex.normSq (FourShell.gap z w j)) ^ 2) := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      ring
    _ = _ := by rw [FourShell.weighted_fourth_sum]

/-- Exact coefficient match to the Taylor polynomial of the general finite
multigap model, using its proved quadratic and quartic tensor identities. -/
theorem glEnergy_matches_multigap (τ ξ g : ℝ) (z w : ℂ) :
    glEnergy τ ξ g z w = MultiGapBCS.glEnergy τ (fun _ => ξ) FourShell.weight
      basis (costMatrix g) (modes z w) := by
  rw [MultiGapBCS.glEnergy_eq_shell_polynomial, quadraticCost_modes]
  simp only [basis_gap, QuarticTensor.intensity_eq_normSq]
  rw [weighted_response_sum, weighted_curvature_sum]
  unfold glEnergy quadraticCoefficient
  ring

/-- The phase-locking coefficient is strictly positive by the actual BCS
curvature theorem; it is not an additional phenomenological input. -/
theorem phase_coefficient_positive {τ ξ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) :
    0 < curvatureKernel τ ξ 0 := by
  exact curvatureKernel_pos hτ (by simpa using sq_pos_of_pos hξ)

/-- Conventional GL coefficients are beta=4*k and gamma=k in this model. -/
theorem glEnergy_coefficient_form (τ ξ g : ℝ) (z w : ℂ) :
    glEnergy τ ξ g z w =
      quadraticCoefficient τ ξ g * FourShell.totalIntensity z w +
      (4 * curvatureKernel τ ξ 0) / 2 * (FourShell.totalIntensity z w) ^ 2 +
      curvatureKernel τ ξ 0 * FourShell.phasePenalty z w := by
  unfold glEnergy
  ring

end Superconductivity.ChiralBCS
```

```lean
import Superconductivity.BCSRemainder
import Superconductivity.MultiGapBCS

/-!
# Uniform multicomponent BCS-to-GL remainder

For every prescribed bound `R > 0` on the total mode intensity, one positive
constant controls every complex mode vector in that ball.  The estimate is
cubic in the total intensity, hence sixth order in the Euclidean mode norm.

The initial existence theorem constructs its constant from scalar Taylor
remainders and explicit finite row bounds. The stronger final theorem gives a
closed coefficient from the actual third derivative and works for every mode
vector without a radius restriction. Both are independent of the quadratic
cost matrix, which cancels exactly. The explicit coefficient depends on
temperature, bare shell energies, weights, and form factors; no uniform
low-temperature or zero-shell-energy limit is asserted.
-/

noncomputable section

open Set
open scoped BigOperators

namespace Superconductivity.MultiGapRemainder

open BCSBridge BCSCurvature BCSThirdDerivative BCSRemainder QuarticTensor MultiGapBCS

variable {Shell Mode : Type*} [Fintype Shell] [Fintype Mode]

/-- Uniform control of the weighted shell remainder over an entire mode ball.
No estimate for the requested remainder occurs among the hypotheses. -/
theorem exists_uniform_shell_sum_bound {τ R : ℝ}
    (ξ w : Shell → ℝ) (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : ∀ j, 0 < ξ j) (hR : 0 < R) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ η : Mode → ℂ, totalIntensity η ≤ R →
      |∑ j, w j * shellRemainder τ (ξ j) (intensity (gap φ η j))|
        ≤ K * totalIntensity η ^ 3 := by
  classical
  have hex : ∀ j : Shell, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ x ∈ Icc 0 (rowBound φ j * R + 1),
        |shellRemainder τ (ξ j) x| ≤ C * x ^ 3 := by
    intro j
    have hr : 0 < rowBound φ j * R + 1 :=
      add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (mul_nonneg (rowBound_nonneg φ j) hR.le) zero_lt_one
    simpa only [shellRemainder_eq_taylor_form] using
      exists_shell_cubic_remainder hτ (hξ j) hr
  let C : Shell → ℝ := fun j => Classical.choose (hex j)
  have hCpos : ∀ j, 0 < C j := fun j => (Classical.choose_spec (hex j)).1
  have hC : ∀ j, ∀ x ∈ Icc 0 (rowBound φ j * R + 1),
      |shellRemainder τ (ξ j) x| ≤ C j * x ^ 3 :=
    fun j => (Classical.choose_spec (hex j)).2
  let M : ℝ := ∑ j, |w j| * C j * rowBound φ j ^ 3
  have hM : 0 ≤ M := by
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro j _hj
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (hCpos j).le)
      (pow_nonneg (rowBound_nonneg φ j) 3)
  refine ⟨M + 1, by linarith, ?_⟩
  intro η hη
  have hS : 0 ≤ totalIntensity η := totalIntensity_nonneg η
  have hterm : ∀ j : Shell,
      |w j * shellRemainder τ (ξ j) (intensity (gap φ η j))| ≤
        (|w j| * C j * rowBound φ j ^ 3) * totalIntensity η ^ 3 := by
    intro j
    have hx : intensity (gap φ η j) ∈ Icc 0 (rowBound φ j * R + 1) := by
      refine ⟨intensity_nonneg _, ?_⟩
      calc
        intensity (gap φ η j) ≤ rowBound φ j * totalIntensity η :=
          gap_intensity_le φ η j
        _ ≤ rowBound φ j * R := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hη (rowBound_nonneg φ j)
        _ ≤ rowBound φ j * R + 1 := by linarith
    have hp : intensity (gap φ η j) ^ 3 ≤
        (rowBound φ j * totalIntensity η) ^ 3 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (intensity_nonneg _) (gap_intensity_le φ η j) 3
    calc
      |w j * shellRemainder τ (ξ j) (intensity (gap φ η j))| =
          |w j| * |shellRemainder τ (ξ j) (intensity (gap φ η j))| := abs_mul _ _
      _ ≤ |w j| * (C j * intensity (gap φ η j) ^ 3) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hC j _ hx) (abs_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ |w j| * (C j * (rowBound φ j * totalIntensity η) ^ 3) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (hCpos j).le) (abs_nonneg _)
      _ = (|w j| * C j * rowBound φ j ^ 3) * totalIntensity η ^ 3 := by ring
  calc
    |∑ j, w j * shellRemainder τ (ξ j) (intensity (gap φ η j))| ≤
        ∑ j, |w j * shellRemainder τ (ξ j) (intensity (gap φ η j))| :=
      Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ j, (|w j| * C j * rowBound φ j ^ 3) * totalIntensity η ^ 3 :=
      Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _hj => hterm j)
    _ = M * totalIntensity η ^ 3 := by rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
    _ ≤ (M + 1) * totalIntensity η ^ 3 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (pow_nonneg hS 3)

/-- A uniform sixth-order BCS-to-GL error over the full complex mode ball.
The same constant works for every quadratic cost matrix, because that term is
identical in the nonpolynomial and quartic energies. -/
theorem exists_uniform_sextic_remainder {τ R : ℝ}
    (ξ w : Shell → ℝ) (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : ∀ j, 0 < ξ j) (hR : 0 < R) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 0 < K ∧ ∀ (A : Mode → Mode → ℂ) (η : Mode → ℂ),
      totalIntensity η ≤ R →
      |MultiGapBCS.freeEnergy τ ξ w φ A η - MultiGapBCS.glEnergy τ ξ w φ A η|
        ≤ K * totalIntensity η ^ 3 := by
  obtain ⟨K, hK, hbound⟩ := exists_uniform_shell_sum_bound ξ w φ hτ hξ hR
  refine ⟨K, hK, ?_⟩
  intro A η hη
  rw [freeEnergy_sub_glEnergy, abs_neg]
  exact hbound η hη

/-- An explicit coefficient for the sixth-order error in total mode norm.
Equivalently this is `(1/6) * ∑ j, |w j| * thirdBound τ (ξ j) * rowBound φ j ^ 3`.
It contains no mode amplitude, quadratic cost matrix, or radius parameter. -/
def sexticCoefficient (τ : ℝ) (ξ w : Shell → ℝ) (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j, |w j| * (thirdBound τ (ξ j) / 6) * rowBound φ j ^ 3

theorem sexticCoefficient_nonneg {τ : ℝ} (ξ w : Shell → ℝ)
    (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ) (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : ∀ j, 0 < ξ j) :
    0 ≤ sexticCoefficient τ ξ w φ := by
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro j _hj
  have hξj := hξ j
  have hB : 0 ≤ thirdBound τ (ξ j) / 6 := by
    unfold thirdBound
    positivity
  exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) hB)
    (pow_nonneg (rowBound_nonneg φ j) 3)

/-- Explicit control of the full multicomponent BCS-to-GL remainder.
The bound holds simultaneously for every complex mode vector.  For large
amplitudes it is a valid but generally loose estimate; its useful asymptotic
content is sixth order near the zero vector. -/
theorem remainder_le_explicit {τ : ℝ}
    (ξ w : Shell → ℝ) (φ : Shell → Mode → ℂ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : ∀ j, 0 < ξ j)
    (A : Mode → Mode → ℂ) (η : Mode → ℂ) :
    |MultiGapBCS.freeEnergy τ ξ w φ A η - MultiGapBCS.glEnergy τ ξ w φ A η|
      ≤ sexticCoefficient τ ξ w φ * totalIntensity η ^ 3 := by
  have hterm : ∀ j : Shell,
      |w j * shellRemainder τ (ξ j) (intensity (gap φ η j))| ≤
        (|w j| * (thirdBound τ (ξ j) / 6) * rowBound φ j ^ 3) *
          totalIntensity η ^ 3 := by
    intro j
    have hshell : |shellRemainder τ (ξ j) (intensity (gap φ η j))| ≤
        thirdBound τ (ξ j) / 6 * intensity (gap φ η j) ^ 3 := by
      rw [shellRemainder_eq_taylor_form]
      exact shell_remainder_le_explicit hτ (hξ j) (intensity_nonneg _)
    have hξj := hξ j
    have hB : 0 ≤ thirdBound τ (ξ j) / 6 := by
      unfold thirdBound
      positivity
    have hp : intensity (gap φ η j) ^ 3 ≤
        (rowBound φ j * totalIntensity η) ^ 3 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (intensity_nonneg _) (gap_intensity_le φ η j) 3
    calc
      |w j * shellRemainder τ (ξ j) (intensity (gap φ η j))| =
          |w j| * |shellRemainder τ (ξ j) (intensity (gap φ η j))| := abs_mul _ _
      _ ≤ |w j| * (thirdBound τ (ξ j) / 6 * intensity (gap φ η j) ^ 3) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hshell (abs_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ |w j| * (thirdBound τ (ξ j) / 6 *
          (rowBound φ j * totalIntensity η) ^ 3) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp hB) (abs_nonneg _)
      _ = (|w j| * (thirdBound τ (ξ j) / 6) * rowBound φ j ^ 3) *
          totalIntensity η ^ 3 := by ring
  rw [freeEnergy_sub_glEnergy, abs_neg]
  calc
    |∑ j, w j * shellRemainder τ (ξ j) (intensity (gap φ η j))| ≤
        ∑ j, |w j * shellRemainder τ (ξ j) (intensity (gap φ η j))| :=
      Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
    _ ≤ ∑ j, (|w j| * (thirdBound τ (ξ j) / 6) * rowBound φ j ^ 3) *
        totalIntensity η ^ 3 := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _hj => hterm j)
    _ = sexticCoefficient τ ξ w φ * totalIntensity η ^ 3 := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_mul]
      rfl

end Superconductivity.MultiGapRemainder
```

```lean
import Superconductivity.MultiGapRemainder
import Superconductivity.ChiralBCS

/-!
# Explicit approximation certificate for the finite chiral BCS example

The example's original nonpolynomial energy and its derived GL polynomial are
the exact instances identified in `ChiralBCS`. This module specializes the
general sixth-order estimate and evaluates its coefficient for the displayed
four-shell basis. The resulting constant is convenient, not optimized.

The tolerance statements compare the remainder with the positive quartic
scale `curvatureKernel τ ξ 0 * totalIntensity z w ^ 2`. They certify the
accuracy of this model's polynomial truncation. They do not certify a material
prediction, a thermodynamic limit, or a relative error against the full energy,
which can vanish through cancellation.
-/

noncomputable section

open scoped BigOperators

namespace Superconductivity.ChiralRemainder

open BCSCurvature BCSThirdDerivative ChiralBCS

/-- The generic row bound is `(2,2,4,4)` and the weights are `(4,4,1,1)`.
Consequently its explicit sixth-order coefficient is `32 * thirdBound`. -/
theorem sexticCoefficient_eq (τ ξ : ℝ) :
    MultiGapRemainder.sexticCoefficient τ (fun _ => ξ) FourShell.weight basis =
      32 * thirdBound τ ξ := by
  simp [MultiGapRemainder.sexticCoefficient, QuarticTensor.rowBound,
    QuarticTensor.intensity, basis, FourShell.weight, Fin.sum_univ_four,
    Fin.sum_univ_two]
  ring

/-- The derived chiral GL energy approximates the same original BCS energy
with an explicit bound, valid for every complex mode pair. -/
theorem remainder_le {τ ξ : ℝ} (g : ℝ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (z w : ℂ) :
    |energy τ ξ g z w - glEnergy τ ξ g z w| ≤
      (32 * thirdBound τ ξ) * FourShell.totalIntensity z w ^ 3 := by
  rw [energy_matches_multigap, glEnergy_matches_multigap]
  have h := MultiGapRemainder.remainder_le_explicit
    (fun _ : Fin 4 => ξ) FourShell.weight basis hτ (fun _ => hξ)
    (costMatrix g) (modes z w)
  simpa only [sexticCoefficient_eq, modes_intensity] using h

/-- A sufficient, directly checkable criterion for the remainder to be no
larger than `ε` times the reference positive quartic scale. -/
theorem remainder_le_quartic_tolerance {τ ξ ε : ℝ} (g : ℝ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (z w : ℂ)
    (htol : (32 * thirdBound τ ξ) * FourShell.totalIntensity z w ≤
      ε * curvatureKernel τ ξ 0) :
    |energy τ ξ g z w - glEnergy τ ξ g z w| ≤
      ε * curvatureKernel τ ξ 0 * FourShell.totalIntensity z w ^ 2 := by
  calc
    |energy τ ξ g z w - glEnergy τ ξ g z w| ≤
        (32 * thirdBound τ ξ) * FourShell.totalIntensity z w ^ 3 :=
      remainder_le g hτ hξ z w
    _ = ((32 * thirdBound τ ξ) * FourShell.totalIntensity z w) *
        FourShell.totalIntensity z w ^ 2 := by ring
    _ ≤ ε * curvatureKernel τ ξ 0 * FourShell.totalIntensity z w ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right htol (sq_nonneg _)

/-- The tolerance criterion expressed as an explicit upper bound on the
total squared mode amplitude. No unknown remainder constant occurs here. -/
theorem remainder_le_quartic_tolerance_of_intensity_le {τ ξ ε : ℝ} (g : ℝ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (z w : ℂ)
    (hsmall : FourShell.totalIntensity z w ≤
      ε * curvatureKernel τ ξ 0 / (32 * thirdBound τ ξ)) :
    |energy τ ξ g z w - glEnergy τ ξ g z w| ≤
      ε * curvatureKernel τ ξ 0 * FourShell.totalIntensity z w ^ 2 := by
  have hM : 0 < 32 * thirdBound τ ξ := by
    unfold thirdBound
    positivity
  apply remainder_le_quartic_tolerance g hτ hξ z w
  have h := (le_div_iff₀ hM).mp hsmall
  simpa only [mul_comm (FourShell.totalIntensity z w)] using h

end Superconductivity.ChiralRemainder
```

```lean
import Superconductivity.BCSRemainder
import Superconductivity.BCSThirdDerivative
import Mathlib.Topology.Order.IntermediateValue

/-!
# Exact radial minimization for the four-shell BCS model

The electronic shell term has the concave sign convention of `BCSBridge`.
The radial free energy therefore subtracts the two shell contributions.
All minimization claims concern this finite mean-field energy on `S ≥ 0`.
-/

noncomputable section

open Set
open scoped Topology

namespace Superconductivity.RadialBCS

open BCSBridge BCSCurvature BCSRemainder

def energy (τ ξ g S : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  S / g - 8 * shellTerm τ ξ (S / 2) - 2 * shellTerm τ ξ S

def residual (τ ξ g S : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  1 / g - 4 * shellResponse τ ξ (S / 2) - 2 * shellResponse τ ξ S

def curvature (τ ξ S : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  2 * curvatureKernel τ ξ (S / 2) + 2 * curvatureKernel τ ξ S

def pairingEigenvalue (τ ξ g : ℝ) : ℝ := 6 * g * shellResponse τ ξ 0

theorem physical_radicands {ξ S : ℝ} (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hS : 0 ≤ S) :
    0 < ξ ^ 2 + S / 2 ∧ 0 < ξ ^ 2 + S := by
  have hsq := sq_pos_of_pos hξ
  constructor <;> linarith

theorem energy_zero (τ g : ℝ) {ξ : ℝ} (hξ : 0 ≤ ξ) :
    energy τ ξ g 0 = 0 := by
  simp [energy, shellTerm_zero τ hξ]

theorem hasDerivAt_energy {τ ξ g S : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ)
    (hr : 0 < ξ ^ 2 + S / 2 ∧ 0 < ξ ^ 2 + S) :
    HasDerivAt (energy τ ξ g) (residual τ ξ g S) S := by
  have hfirst := ((hasDerivAt_shellTerm hτ hr.1).comp S
    ((hasDerivAt_id S).div_const 2)).const_mul 8
  have hsecond := (hasDerivAt_shellTerm hτ hr.2).const_mul 2
  have h := (((hasDerivAt_id S).div_const g).sub hfirst).sub hsecond
  refine h.congr_deriv ?_
  unfold residual
  ring

theorem deriv_energy {τ ξ g S : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ)
    (hr : 0 < ξ ^ 2 + S / 2 ∧ 0 < ξ ^ 2 + S) :
    deriv (energy τ ξ g) S = residual τ ξ g S :=
  (hasDerivAt_energy hτ hr).deriv

theorem hasDerivAt_residual {τ ξ g S : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ)
    (hr : 0 < ξ ^ 2 + S / 2 ∧ 0 < ξ ^ 2 + S) :
    HasDerivAt (residual τ ξ g) (curvature τ ξ S) S := by
  have hfirst := ((hasDerivAt_shellResponse hτ hr.1).comp S
    ((hasDerivAt_id S).div_const 2)).const_mul 4
  have hsecond := (hasDerivAt_shellResponse hτ hr.2).const_mul 2
  have h := ((hasDerivAt_const S (1 / g)).sub hfirst).sub hsecond
  refine h.congr_deriv ?_
  unfold curvature
  ring

theorem hasDerivAt_deriv_energy {τ ξ g S : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ)
    (hr : 0 < ξ ^ 2 + S / 2 ∧ 0 < ξ ^ 2 + S) :
    HasDerivAt (deriv (energy τ ξ g)) (curvature τ ξ S) S := by
  apply (hasDerivAt_residual hτ hr).congr_of_eventuallyEq
  have he1 : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 S, 0 < ξ ^ 2 + y / 2 :=
    continuousAt_const.eventually_lt
      (continuousAt_const.add (continuousAt_id.div_const 2)) hr.1
  have he2 : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 S, 0 < ξ ^ 2 + y :=
    continuousAt_const.eventually_lt (continuousAt_const.add continuousAt_id) hr.2
  exact (he1.and he2).mono (fun y hy => deriv_energy hτ hy)

theorem deriv_deriv_energy {τ ξ g S : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ)
    (hr : 0 < ξ ^ 2 + S / 2 ∧ 0 < ξ ^ 2 + S) :
    deriv (deriv (energy τ ξ g)) S = curvature τ ξ S :=
  (hasDerivAt_deriv_energy hτ hr).deriv

theorem curvature_pos {τ ξ S : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ)
    (hr : 0 < ξ ^ 2 + S / 2 ∧ 0 < ξ ^ 2 + S) :
    0 < curvature τ ξ S := by
  have hfirst := curvatureKernel_pos hτ hr.1
  have hsecond := curvatureKernel_pos hτ hr.2
  unfold curvature
  linarith

theorem strictConvexOn_energy {τ ξ g : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) :
    StrictConvexOn ℝ (Ici 0) (energy τ ξ g) := by
  apply strictConvexOn_of_deriv2_pos' (convex_Ici 0)
    (fun x hx => (hasDerivAt_energy hτ (physical_radicands hξ hx)).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
  intro x hx
  change 0 < deriv (deriv (energy τ ξ g)) x
  rw [deriv_deriv_energy hτ (physical_radicands hξ hx)]
  exact curvature_pos hτ (physical_radicands hξ hx)

theorem residual_zero (τ ξ : ℝ) {g : ℝ} (hg : g ≠ 0) :
    residual τ ξ g 0 = (1 - pairingEigenvalue τ ξ g) / g := by
  unfold residual pairingEigenvalue
  simp only [zero_div]
  field_simp
  ring

theorem pairingEigenvalue_formula (τ g : ℝ) {ξ : ℝ} (hξ : 0 ≤ ξ) :
    pairingEigenvalue τ ξ g =
      6 * g * (Real.tanh (ξ / (2 * τ)) / (2 * ξ)) := by
  simp only [pairingEigenvalue, shellResponse, quasiparticleEnergy_zero hξ]

theorem residual_zero_nonneg_iff (τ ξ : ℝ) {g : ℝ} (hg : 0 < g) :
    0 ≤ residual τ ξ g 0 ↔ pairingEigenvalue τ ξ g ≤ 1 := by
  rw [residual_zero τ ξ (ne_of_gt hg), le_div_iff₀ hg]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

theorem residual_zero_neg_iff (τ ξ : ℝ) {g : ℝ} (hg : 0 < g) :
    residual τ ξ g 0 < 0 ↔ 1 < pairingEigenvalue τ ξ g := by
  rw [residual_zero τ ξ (ne_of_gt hg), div_lt_iff₀ hg]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

theorem stationary_strict_minimum {τ ξ g x : ℝ}
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hx : 0 ≤ x)
    (hstat : residual τ ξ g x = 0) :
    ∀ y, 0 ≤ y → y ≠ x → energy τ ξ g x < energy τ ξ g y := by
  intro y hy hne
  have hc := strictConvexOn_energy (g := g) hτ hξ
  have hd := hasDerivAt_energy (g := g) hτ (physical_radicands hξ hx)
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hgt
  · have hs := hc.slope_lt_of_hasDerivAt hy hx hlt hd
    rw [hstat, slope_def_field] at hs
    have hnum := (div_lt_iff₀ (sub_pos.mpr hlt)).mp hs
    linarith
  · have hs := hc.lt_slope_of_hasDerivAt hx hy hgt hd
    rw [hstat, slope_def_field] at hs
    have hnum := (lt_div_iff₀ (sub_pos.mpr hgt)).mp hs
    linarith

theorem normal_strict_minimum {τ ξ g : ℝ}
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hg : 0 < g)
    (hl : pairingEigenvalue τ ξ g ≤ 1) :
    ∀ S, 0 < S → energy τ ξ g 0 < energy τ ξ g S := by
  intro S hS
  have hc := strictConvexOn_energy (g := g) hτ hξ
  have hd := hasDerivAt_energy (g := g) hτ (physical_radicands hξ (le_refl 0))
  have hs := hc.lt_slope_of_hasDerivAt
    (show (0 : ℝ) ∈ Ici 0 by simp) hS.le hS hd
  have hr := (residual_zero_nonneg_iff τ ξ hg).mpr hl
  rw [slope_def_field] at hs
  have hnum := (lt_div_iff₀ (by linarith : 0 < S - 0)).mp hs
  have hprod := mul_nonneg hr hS.le
  linarith

theorem shellResponse_upper_bound {τ ξ g x : ℝ}
    (hg : 0 < g) (hx : 36 * g ^ 2 ≤ x) :
    shellResponse τ ξ x ≤ 1 / (12 * g) := by
  have hr : 0 < ξ ^ 2 + x := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ξ, sq_pos_of_pos hg]
  have hEpos := quasiparticleEnergy_pos hr
  have hEsq : quasiparticleEnergy ξ x ^ 2 = ξ ^ 2 + x :=
    Real.sq_sqrt hr.le
  have hElower : 6 * g ≤ quasiparticleEnergy ξ x := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg ξ]
  have ht : Real.tanh (quasiparticleEnergy ξ x / (2 * τ)) ≤ 1 :=
    (le_abs_self _).trans (BCSThirdDerivative.abs_tanh_le_one _)
  unfold shellResponse
  calc
    _ ≤ 1 / (2 * quasiparticleEnergy ξ x) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ht (by positivity)
    _ ≤ 1 / (12 * g) :=
      one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) (by linarith)

theorem residual_at_upper_bound_pos {τ ξ g : ℝ} (hg : 0 < g) :
    0 < residual τ ξ g (72 * g ^ 2) := by
  have hfirst := shellResponse_upper_bound (τ := τ) (ξ := ξ) hg
    (show 36 * g ^ 2 ≤ (72 * g ^ 2) / 2 by linarith)
  have hsecond := shellResponse_upper_bound (τ := τ) (ξ := ξ) hg
    (show 36 * g ^ 2 ≤ 72 * g ^ 2 by nlinarith [sq_nonneg g])
  have hrec : 1 / g - 4 * (1 / (12 * g)) - 2 * (1 / (12 * g)) = 1 / (2 * g) := by
    field_simp
    ring
  have hpos : 0 < 1 / (2 * g) := by positivity
  unfold residual
  linarith

theorem exists_positive_stationary {τ ξ g : ℝ}
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hg : 0 < g)
    (hl : 1 < pairingEigenvalue τ ξ g) :
    ∃ S, 0 < S ∧ S < 72 * g ^ 2 ∧ residual τ ξ g S = 0 := by
  have hupper : 0 < 72 * g ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (residual τ ξ g) (Icc 0 (72 * g ^ 2)) :=
    fun x hx => (hasDerivAt_residual (g := g) hτ
      (physical_radicands hξ hx.1)).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have hzero := (residual_zero_neg_iff τ ξ hg).mpr hl
  have hlast := residual_at_upper_bound_pos (τ := τ) (ξ := ξ) hg
  obtain ⟨S, hS, heq⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc hupper.le hcont
    (show (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc (residual τ ξ g 0) (residual τ ξ g (72 * g ^ 2)) from
      ⟨hzero.le, hlast.le⟩)
  refine ⟨S, ?_, ?_, heq⟩
  · have hne : S ≠ 0 := by intro he; subst S; linarith
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hS.1 (Ne.symm hne)
  · have hne : S ≠ 72 * g ^ 2 := by intro he; subst S; linarith
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne hS.2 hne

theorem exists_unique_positive_global_minimum {τ ξ g : ℝ}
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hg : 0 < g)
    (hl : 1 < pairingEigenvalue τ ξ g) :
    ∃ S, 0 < S ∧ S < 72 * g ^ 2 ∧ residual τ ξ g S = 0 ∧
      (∀ y, 0 ≤ y → energy τ ξ g S ≤ energy τ ξ g y) ∧
      (∀ y, 0 ≤ y → energy τ ξ g y = energy τ ξ g S → y = S) := by
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hbound, hstat⟩ := exists_positive_stationary hτ hξ hg hl
  have hstrict := stationary_strict_minimum hτ hξ hS.le hstat
  refine ⟨S, hS, hbound, hstat, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y hy
    by_cases he : y = S
    · subst y
      exact le_refl _
    · exact (hstrict y hy he).le
  · intro y hy he
    by_contra hne
    have hlt := hstrict y hy hne
    linarith

theorem zero_global_minimum_iff {τ ξ g : ℝ}
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hg : 0 < g) :
    (∀ S, 0 ≤ S → energy τ ξ g 0 ≤ energy τ ξ g S) ↔
      pairingEigenvalue τ ξ g ≤ 1 := by
  constructor
  · intro hmin
    by_contra hn
    have hl : 1 < pairingEigenvalue τ ξ g := lt_of_not_ge hn
    obtain ⟨S, hS, _hbound, hstat⟩ := exists_positive_stationary hτ hξ hg hl
    have hlt := stationary_strict_minimum hτ hξ hS.le hstat 0 (le_refl 0) (ne_of_lt hS)
    have hle := hmin S hS.le
    linarith
  · intro hl S hS
    rcases hS.eq_or_lt with hzero | hpos
    · subst S
      exact le_refl _
    · exact (normal_strict_minimum hτ hξ hg hl S hpos).le

theorem positive_global_minimum_iff {τ ξ g : ℝ}
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hg : 0 < g) :
    (∃ S, 0 < S ∧ ∀ y, 0 ≤ y → energy τ ξ g S ≤ energy τ ξ g y) ↔
      1 < pairingEigenvalue τ ξ g := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨S, hS, hmin⟩
    by_contra hn
    have hl : pairingEigenvalue τ ξ g ≤ 1 := le_of_not_gt hn
    have hlt := normal_strict_minimum hτ hξ hg hl S hS
    have hle := hmin 0 (le_refl 0)
    linarith
  · intro hl
    obtain ⟨S, hS, _hbound, _hstat, hmin, _hunique⟩ :=
      exists_unique_positive_global_minimum hτ hξ hg hl
    exact ⟨S, hS, hmin⟩

theorem normal_unique_global_minimum {τ ξ g : ℝ}
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hg : 0 < g)
    (hl : pairingEigenvalue τ ξ g ≤ 1) :
    ∀ S, 0 ≤ S →
      ((∀ y, 0 ≤ y → energy τ ξ g S ≤ energy τ ξ g y) ↔ S = 0) := by
  intro S hS
  constructor
  · intro hmin
    by_contra hne
    have hpos : 0 < S := lt_of_le_of_ne hS (Ne.symm hne)
    have hlt := normal_strict_minimum hτ hξ hg hl S hpos
    have hle := hmin 0 (le_refl 0)
    linarith
  · intro hz
    subst S
    exact (zero_global_minimum_iff hτ hξ hg).mpr hl

end Superconductivity.RadialBCS
```

```lean
import Superconductivity.RadialBCS
import Superconductivity.ChiralBCS

/-!
# Complete global minimizers of the specified four-shell BCS energy

This module combines the exact complex-direction reduction with the proved
existence and uniqueness of the radial minimum. The parameter threshold is
also connected to the explicitly computed two-dimensional pairing matrix.
These statements concern a finite mean-field variational model, not a
thermodynamic phase transition or a material prediction.
-/

noncomputable section

open scoped BigOperators

namespace Superconductivity.ChiralTransition

def IsGlobalMinimizer (τ ξ g : ℝ) (z w : ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ z' w' : ℂ, ChiralBCS.energy τ ξ g z w ≤ ChiralBCS.energy τ ξ g z' w'

theorem radialEnergy_eq (τ ξ g S : ℝ) :
    ChiralBCS.radialEnergy τ ξ g S = RadialBCS.energy τ ξ g S := rfl

theorem radialMinimizer_iff (τ ξ g S : ℝ) :
    ChiralBCS.IsRadialMinimizer τ ξ g S ↔
      0 ≤ S ∧ ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → RadialBCS.energy τ ξ g S ≤ RadialBCS.energy τ ξ g t :=
  Iff.rfl

theorem global_minimizer_iff {τ ξ g : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : 0 < ξ)
    (z w : ℂ) :
    IsGlobalMinimizer τ ξ g z w ↔
      (w = Complex.I * z ∨ w = -Complex.I * z) ∧
      0 ≤ FourShell.totalIntensity z w ∧
      ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → RadialBCS.energy τ ξ g (FourShell.totalIntensity z w) ≤
        RadialBCS.energy τ ξ g t := by
  rw [IsGlobalMinimizer, ChiralBCS.global_minimizer_iff g hτ hξ, radialMinimizer_iff]

theorem normal_global_minimizer_iff_zero {τ ξ g : ℝ}
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hg : 0 < g)
    (hl : RadialBCS.pairingEigenvalue τ ξ g ≤ 1) (z w : ℂ) :
    IsGlobalMinimizer τ ξ g z w ↔ z = 0 ∧ w = 0 := by
  rw [global_minimizer_iff hτ hξ]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_hphase, hS, hmin⟩
    have hzero := (RadialBCS.normal_unique_global_minimum hτ hξ hg hl
      (FourShell.totalIntensity z w) hS).mp hmin
    exact (FourShell.totalIntensity_eq_zero_iff z w).mp hzero
  · rintro ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    have hzero : FourShell.totalIntensity (0 : ℂ) 0 = 0 := by simp [FourShell.totalIntensity]
    rw [hzero]
    refine ⟨Or.inl (by simp), le_refl 0, ?_⟩
    exact (RadialBCS.zero_global_minimum_iff hτ hξ hg).mpr hl

theorem ordered_global_minimizer_iff {τ ξ g S : ℝ}
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hS : 0 ≤ S)
    (hmin : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t → RadialBCS.energy τ ξ g S ≤ RadialBCS.energy τ ξ g t)
    (hunique : ∀ t, 0 ≤ t →
      RadialBCS.energy τ ξ g t = RadialBCS.energy τ ξ g S → t = S)
    (z w : ℂ) :
    IsGlobalMinimizer τ ξ g z w ↔
      FourShell.totalIntensity z w = S ∧
        (w = Complex.I * z ∨ w = -Complex.I * z) := by
  rw [global_minimizer_iff hτ hξ]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hphase, hzw, hzwmin⟩
    have he := le_antisymm (hzwmin S hS) (hmin _ hzw)
    exact ⟨hunique _ hzw he, hphase⟩
  · rintro ⟨he, hphase⟩
    rw [he]
    exact ⟨hphase, hS, hmin⟩

theorem exists_ordered_global_classification {τ ξ g : ℝ}
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hg : 0 < g)
    (hl : 1 < RadialBCS.pairingEigenvalue τ ξ g) :
    ∃ S, 0 < S ∧ S < 72 * g ^ 2 ∧ RadialBCS.residual τ ξ g S = 0 ∧
      (∀ z w, IsGlobalMinimizer τ ξ g z w ↔
        FourShell.totalIntensity z w = S ∧
          (w = Complex.I * z ∨ w = -Complex.I * z)) ∧
      IsGlobalMinimizer τ ξ g (ConvexPhase.firstMode S) (ConvexPhase.secondMode S) ∧
      ConvexPhase.firstMode S ≠ 0 ∧ ConvexPhase.secondMode S ≠ 0 := by
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hbound, hstat, hmin, hunique⟩ :=
    RadialBCS.exists_unique_positive_global_minimum hτ hξ hg hl
  have hclass := ordered_global_minimizer_iff hτ hξ hS.le hmin hunique
  have hconstruct := (hclass (ConvexPhase.firstMode S) (ConvexPhase.secondMode S)).mpr
    ⟨ConvexPhase.constructed_intensity S hS.le, Or.inl rfl⟩
  have hnz := ConvexPhase.constructed_both_nonzero S hS
  exact ⟨S, hS, hbound, hstat, hclass, hconstruct, hnz⟩

theorem exists_unique_ordered_intensity {τ ξ g : ℝ}
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hg : 0 < g)
    (hl : 1 < RadialBCS.pairingEigenvalue τ ξ g) :
    ∃! S : ℝ, 0 < S ∧
      ∀ z w, IsGlobalMinimizer τ ξ g z w ↔
        FourShell.totalIntensity z w = S ∧
          (w = Complex.I * z ∨ w = -Complex.I * z) := by
  obtain ⟨S, hS, _hbound, _hstat, hclass, hconstruct, _hnz⟩ :=
    exists_ordered_global_classification hτ hξ hg hl
  refine ⟨S, ⟨hS, hclass⟩, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  have he := ((ht.2 (ConvexPhase.firstMode S) (ConvexPhase.secondMode S)).mp hconstruct).1
  rw [ConvexPhase.constructed_intensity S hS.le] at he
  exact he.symm

theorem nonzero_global_minimizer_iff {τ ξ g : ℝ}
    (hτ : 0 < τ) (hξ : 0 < ξ) (hg : 0 < g) :
    (∃ z w : ℂ, (z ≠ 0 ∨ w ≠ 0) ∧ IsGlobalMinimizer τ ξ g z w) ↔
      1 < RadialBCS.pairingEigenvalue τ ξ g := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨z, w, hnz, hmin⟩
    by_contra hn
    have hz := (normal_global_minimizer_iff_zero hτ hξ hg (le_of_not_gt hn) z w).mp hmin
    rcases hnz with hnz | hnz
    · exact hnz hz.1
    · exact hnz hz.2
  · intro hl
    obtain ⟨S, _hS, _hbound, _hstat, _hclass, hmin, hz, _hw⟩ :=
      exists_ordered_global_classification hτ hξ hg hl
    exact ⟨_, _, Or.inl hz, hmin⟩

/-- Gram matrix of the actual real pairing basis with its specified shell weights. -/
def weightedGram (a b : Fin 2) : ℂ :=
  ∑ j, (FourShell.weight j : ℂ) * star (ChiralBCS.basis j a) * ChiralBCS.basis j b

theorem weightedGram_entry (a b : Fin 2) :
    weightedGram a b = if a = b then 6 else 0 := by
  fin_cases a <;> fin_cases b <;> rw [weightedGram, Fin.sum_univ_four]
  · change (4 : ℂ) * star 1 * 1 + 4 * star 0 * 0 + 1 * star 1 * 1 +
      1 * star 1 * 1 = 6
    norm_num
  · change (4 : ℂ) * star 1 * 0 + 4 * star 0 * 1 + 1 * star 1 * 1 +
      1 * star 1 * (-1) = 0
    norm_num
  · change (4 : ℂ) * star 0 * 1 + 4 * star 1 * 0 + 1 * star 1 * 1 +
      1 * star (-1) * 1 = 0
    norm_num
  · change (4 : ℂ) * star 0 * 0 + 4 * star 1 * 1 + 1 * star 1 * 1 +
      1 * star (-1) * (-1) = 6
    norm_num

/-- The linearized pairing response for scalar attractive coupling `g`. -/
def pairingMatrix (τ ξ g : ℝ) (a b : Fin 2) : ℂ :=
  ((g * BCSBridge.shellResponse τ ξ 0 : ℝ) : ℂ) * weightedGram a b

theorem pairingMatrix_entry (τ ξ g : ℝ) (a b : Fin 2) :
    pairingMatrix τ ξ g a b =
      if a = b then (RadialBCS.pairingEigenvalue τ ξ g : ℂ) else 0 := by
  unfold pairingMatrix
  rw [weightedGram_entry]
  split_ifs
  · simp only [RadialBCS.pairingEigenvalue, Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_ofNat]
    ring
  · simp

/-- Every vector in the two-dimensional mode space has the same linearized
pairing eigenvalue. The matrix is computed from the model's actual basis. -/
theorem pairingMatrix_action (τ ξ g : ℝ) (v : Fin 2 → ℂ) (a : Fin 2) :
    (∑ b, pairingMatrix τ ξ g a b * v b) =
      (RadialBCS.pairingEigenvalue τ ξ g : ℂ) * v a := by
  classical
  simp [pairingMatrix_entry, ite_mul]

theorem first_coordinate_mode_nonzero : ChiralBCS.modes (1 : ℂ) 0 ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have hz := congrFun h 0
  norm_num [ChiralBCS.modes] at hz

theorem second_coordinate_mode_nonzero : ChiralBCS.modes (0 : ℂ) 1 ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have hz := congrFun h 1
  norm_num [ChiralBCS.modes] at hz

/-- The two displayed eigenvectors are linearly independent, rather than two
names for the same scalar-gap direction. -/
theorem coordinate_modes_independent (a b : ℂ)
    (h : (fun i => a * ChiralBCS.modes 1 0 i + b * ChiralBCS.modes 0 1 i) = 0) :
    a = 0 ∧ b = 0 := by
  constructor
  · have hz := congrFun h 0
    simpa [ChiralBCS.modes] using hz
  · have hw := congrFun h 1
    simpa [ChiralBCS.modes] using hw

end Superconductivity.ChiralTransition
```
